1.211.m: Even when supreme expiation has been performed by me, O sinless father, / what shall I do? Where shall I go? O father, my pains are extreme!

1.211.s:
kṛtena karmaṇā yena alpāyāsena me vibho ..
naśyettu brahmahatyeyaṃ vyādhiścāyaṃ paraṃtapa .. 10 ..
1.211.d:
कृतेन कर्मणा येन अल्पायासेन मे विभो ॥
नश्येत्तु ब्रह्महत्येयं व्याधिश्चायं परंतप ॥ 10 ॥
1.211.m: By performing what rite with little effort, O lord, / would this slaying of a brāhmaṇa and this disease be destroyed, O scorcher of foes?

1.211.s:
kathyatāṃ mā ciraṃ tāta kuru niḥśreyasaṃ mama ..
hiraṇyanābho viprastu śrutvā vākyaṃ sutasya tu ..
śokaduḥkhābhibhūtastu vākyaṃ putramuvāca ha .. 11 ..
1.211.d:
कथ्यतां मा चिरं तात कुरु निःश्रेयसं मम ॥
हिरण्यनाभो विप्रस्तु श्रुत्वा वाक्यं सुतस्य तु ॥
शोकदुःखाभिभूतस्तु वाक्यं पुत्रमुवाच ह ॥ 11 ॥
1.211.m: Tell me without delay, O father; bring about my highest welfare!” / Having heard the words of his son, the brāhmaṇa Hiraṇyanābha, / overcome by sorrow and grief, spoke these words to his son:

1.211.s:
.. hiraṇyanābha uvāca .. ..
jñātaḥ putra tava kleśaḥ prāpto yastvayāṭatā mahīm .. 12 ..
1.211.d:
॥ हिरण्यनाभ उवाच ॥ ॥
ज्ञातः पुत्र तव क्लेशः प्राप्तो यस्त्वयाटता महीम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.211.m: Hiraṇyanābha said: / “Known, O son, is your suffering, which was incurred by you as you wandered the earth,

1.211.s:
tīrthāni ca tvayā vatsa prāyaścittāni kurvatā ..
na cāpi brahmahatyā tvāṃ muṃcate matkulodvaha .. 13 ..
1.211.d:
तीर्थानि च त्वया वत्स प्रायश्चित्तानि कुर्वता ॥
न चापि ब्रह्महत्या त्वां मुंचते मत्कुलोद्वह ॥ 13 ॥
1.211.m: and visited sacred bathing-places, O child, while performing expiations; / yet the slaying of a brāhmaṇa does not release you, O upholder of my lineage.

1.211.s:
upāyamekaṃ vakṣyāmi yena tvaṃ mokṣamāpsyasi ..
alpāyāsena vai putra śṛṇuṣva gadato mama .. 14 ..
1.211.d:
उपायमेकं वक्ष्यामि येन त्वं मोक्षमाप्स्यसि ॥
अल्पायासेन वै पुत्र शृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥ 14 ॥
1.211.m: I shall tell you a single means by which you will attain liberation / with little effort indeed, O son; listen to me as I speak.”

1.211.s:
.. kauthumiruvāca .. ..
ārādhayāmi kaṃ devaṃ brahmādīnāṃ kathaṃ vibho ..
śarīreṇa vihīno'smi hetunā sarvakarmaṇām .. 15 ..
1.211.d:
॥ कौथुमिरुवाच ॥ ॥
आराधयामि कं देवं ब्रह्मादीनां कथं विभो ॥
शरीरेण विहीनोऽस्मि हेतुना सर्वकर्मणाम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.211.m: Kauthumi said: / “Which god among Brahmā and the rest shall I worship, and how, O lord? / I am deprived of my body, the instrument of all actions!”

1.211.s:
.. hiraṇyanābha uvāca .. ..
siddhisaṃtatiyuktena karmaṇā tuṣṭimāpnuyuḥ ..
devairapi supūjyoyamupalepanamārjanaiḥ .. 16 ..
1.211.d:
॥ हिरण्यनाभ उवाच ॥ ॥
सिद्धिसंततियुक्तेन कर्मणा तुष्टिमाप्नुयुः ॥
देवैरपि सुपूज्योयमुपलेपनमार्जनैः ॥ 16 ॥
1.211.m: Hiraṇyanābha said: / “[Other gods] would find satisfaction through rites involving a succession of ritual attainments; / but this one is easily worshipped even by the gods through anointing and sweeping.

1.211.s:
bhānureko dvijaśreṣṭha ūcurevaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ ..
brahmā viṣṇurmahādevo jaleśo dhanadastathā .. .. 17 ..
1.211.d:
भानुरेको द्विजश्रेष्ठ ऊचुरेवं मनीषिणः ॥
ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महादेवो जलेशो धनदस्तथा ॥ ॥ 17 ॥
1.211.m: The Sun alone [is such], O best of twice-born; thus have the wise declared. / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Mahādeva, the Lord of Waters, and likewise the Bestower of Wealth—

1.211.s:
bhānumāśritya sarve te modaṃte divi putraka ..
tasmādbhānoḥ samaṃ devaṃ nāhaṃ paśyāmi kaṃcana .. 18 ..
1.211.d:
भानुमाश्रित्य सर्वे ते मोदंते दिवि पुत्रक ॥
तस्माद्भानोः समं देवं नाहं पश्यामि कंचन ॥ 18 ॥
1.211.m: having resorted to the Sun, all of them rejoice in heaven, O dear son. / Therefore, I see no god equal to the Sun.

1.211.s:
evaṃ bhānuṃ sarvamānyamadhunā khilakāmadam ..
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ tāta narāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
1.211.d:
एवं भानुं सर्वमान्यमधुना खिलकामदम् ॥
पितरं मातरं तात नराणां नात्र संशयः ॥ 19 ॥
1.211.m: Thus the Sun, honoured by all, now grants all desires; / he is the father and the mother of human beings, O child, of this there is no doubt.

1.211.s:
tamārādhaya vai bhaktyā japanmaṃtramanuttamam ..
itihāsapurāṇāni śṛṣu śraddhā samanvitaḥ .. 20 ..
1.211.d:
तमाराधय वै भक्त्या जपन्मंत्रमनुत्तमम् ॥
इतिहासपुराणानि शृषु श्रद्धा समन्वितः ॥ 20 ॥
1.211.m: Worship him with devotion, muttering the unsurpassed mantra, / and listen to the Itihāsas and Purāṇas endowed with faith.”

1.211.s:
ārādhayanraviṃ bhaktyā japansāma mahāmate ..
purāṇāni tato loke mokṣaṃ prāpsyasi putraka .. 21 ..
1.211.d:
आराधयन्रविं भक्त्या जपन्साम महामते ॥
पुराणानि ततो लोके मोक्षं प्राप्स्यसि पुत्रक ॥ 21 ॥
1.211.m: Worshipping the Sun with devotion, chanting the sāman, O highly intelligent one, / and listening to the Purāṇas in this world, you shall attain liberation, my son.

1.211.s:
.. kauthumiruvāca .. ..
diśa sāmāni vai tāta pravarāṇi mahāmate..
oṃkārapravarodgīthaṃ prasthānaṃ ca catuṣṭayam.. 22 ..
1.211.d:
॥ कौथुमिरुवाच ॥ ॥
दिश सामानि वै तात प्रवराणि महामते॥
ओंकारप्रवरोद्गीथं प्रस्थानं च चतुष्टयम्॥ 22 ॥
1.211.m: Kauthumi said: / Teach me the foremost sāmans, father, O highly intelligent one: / the foremost syllable Oṃ, the Udgītha, and the fourfold Prasthāna;

1.211.s:
paṃcamaḥ parihārotra ṣaṣṭhamāhustamadbhutam..
nidhanaṃ saptamaṃ sāmnāṃ sāptavidhyamiti smṛtam ..23..
1.211.d:
पंचमः परिहारोत्र षष्ठमाहुस्तमद्भुतम्॥
निधनं सप्तमं साम्नां साप्तविध्यमिति स्मृतम् ॥23॥
1.211.m: the fifth is Parihāra here; the sixth they call wonderful; / the seventh is the Nidhana—thus the sevenfold division of sāmans is remembered.

1.211.s:
sāptavidhyamiti proktaṃ hiṃkārapraṇaveṣu ca..
aṣṭamaṃ ca tava śāṭhyaṃ navamaṃ vāmadevikam ..24...
1.211.d:
साप्तविध्यमिति प्रोक्तं हिंकारप्रणवेषु च॥
अष्टमं च तव शाठ्यं नवमं वामदेविकम् ॥24॥।
1.211.m: The sevenfold division has been taught thus, and also with the syllable Hiṃ and the Praṇava; / and the eighth is Śāṭhya, and the ninth Vāmadevika;

1.211.s:
jyeṣṭhaṃ tu daśamaṃ sāma vedhase priyamuttayam ..
eteṣāṃ tāta sāmnāṃ vai kaṃṭhe jāpyaṃ paraṃ matam ..
japitvā tu ahaṃ śaktyā gacchāmi paramaṃ padam .. 25 .. ..
1.211.d:
ज्येष्ठं तु दशमं साम वेधसे प्रियमुत्तयम् ॥
एतेषां तात साम्नां वै कंठे जाप्यं परं मतम् ॥
जपित्वा तु अहं शक्त्या गच्छामि परमं पदम् ॥ 25 ॥ ॥
1.211.m: and the Jyeṣṭha is the tenth sāman, supreme and dear to the Creator. / Among these sāmans, father, reciting them by heart is considered supreme; / having chanted them according to my ability, I shall go to the supreme abode.

1.211.s:
.. hiraṇyanābha uvāca .. ..
sādhu putra kulaṃ pūtaṃ tvatputreṇa samena ca .. 26..
1.211.d:
॥ हिरण्यनाभ उवाच ॥ ॥
साधु पुत्र कुलं पूतं त्वत्पुत्रेण समेन च ॥ 26॥
1.211.m: Hiraṇyanābha said: / Well done, my son! Our lineage has been purified by you, equal [to the ancestors] as a son.

1.211.s:
evaṃ gatasyāpi hi te jātā putra vidheḥ smṛtiḥ ..
evaṃ tāta na saṃdehaḥ sāmānyetāni putraka .. 27 ..
1.211.d:
एवं गतस्यापि हि ते जाता पुत्र विधेः स्मृतिः ॥
एवं तात न संदेहः सामान्येतानि पुत्रक ॥ 27 ॥
1.211.m: Even having come to such a state, son, memory of the proper rite has arisen in you. / Thus, father, there is no doubt; these are the sāmans, my son.

1.211.s:
pravarāṇi hi sāmnā vai brahmaṇā kathitāni ha ..
eṣāmapi paraṃ proktaṃ sāmadvayamanuttamam ..
tasmādekaṃ paraṃ jāpyaṃ sarva pāpabhayāpaham .. 28 ..
1.211.d:
प्रवराणि हि साम्ना वै ब्रह्मणा कथितानि ह ॥
एषामपि परं प्रोक्तं सामद्वयमनुत्तमम् ॥
तस्मादेकं परं जाप्यं सर्व पापभयापहम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.211.m: Indeed, the foremost sāmans were proclaimed by Brahmā. / Even higher than these, an unsurpassed pair of sāmans has been taught; / of those, one supreme recitation dispels all sin and fear.

1.211.s:
.. kauthumiruvāca .. ..
kathyatāṃ tāta tacchīghraṃ yattu sāmadvayaṃ param ..
eteṣāṃ tāta sāmnāṃ tu nānyajjāpyaṃ ca yadbhavet .. 29 ..
1.211.d:
॥ कौथुमिरुवाच ॥ ॥
कथ्यतां तात तच्छीघ्रं यत्तु सामद्वयं परम् ॥
एतेषां तात साम्नां तु नान्यज्जाप्यं च यद्भवेत् ॥ 29 ॥
1.211.m: Kauthumi said: / Father, tell me quickly that supreme pair of sāmans, / beyond which there is no other recitation among these sāmans.

1.211.s:
.. hiraṇyanābha uvāca .. ..
jyeṣṭhasāmaparaṃ pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ gadataḥ śṛṇu .. 30 ..
1.211.d:
॥ हिरण्यनाभ उवाच ॥ ॥
ज्येष्ठसामपरं पूर्वं द्वितीयं गदतः शृणु ॥ 30 ॥
1.211.m: Hiraṇyanābha said: / The Jyeṣṭhasāman is the supreme first; hear the second as I speak of it.

1.211.s:
tataḥ śrāvyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu japtavyaṃ muktimicchatā ..
tataśca paramaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ devena bhānunā .. 31 ..
1.211.d:
ततः श्राव्यं तृतीयं तु जप्तव्यं मुक्तिमिच्छता ॥
ततश्च परमं प्रोक्तं स्वयं देवेन भानुना ॥ 31 ॥
1.211.m: Then there is the third, to be heard and recited by one desiring liberation; / and beyond that, the supreme one was proclaimed by the god Bhānu himself.

1.211.s:
svayaṃ daivatamādiṣṭaṃ chaṃdasāmuttamaṃ vratam ..
priyaṃ hiraṇyagarbhasya priyaṃ sūryasya sarvadā .. 32 ..
1.211.d:
स्वयं दैवतमादिष्टं छंदसामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥
प्रियं हिरण्यगर्भस्य प्रियं सूर्यस्य सर्वदा ॥ 32 ॥
1.211.m: The deity itself ordained this foremost vow among Vedic meters; / it is dear to Hiraṇyagarbha, and ever dear to the Sun.

1.211.s:
japaśca viniyogopi lakṣaṇaṃ ca nibodha me ..
satyena svaralīnastu śūkarādi smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ .. 33 ..
1.211.d:
जपश्च विनियोगोपि लक्षणं च निबोध मे ॥
सत्येन स्वरलीनस्तु शूकरादि स्मृतं बुधैः ॥ 33 ॥
1.211.m: Understand from me the recitation, the ritual application, and its characteristic mark: / absorbed in the tone through truth, it is remembered by the wise beginning with Śūkara;

1.211.s:
ṛturbhāvastathā dharmo vidharmaḥ satyakṛttathā ..
dharmādharmau tathā kāryau dharmavedaname va ca .. 34 ..
1.211.d:
ऋतुर्भावस्तथा धर्मो विधर्मः सत्यकृत्तथा ॥
धर्माधर्मौ तथा कार्यौ धर्मवेदनमे व च ॥ 34 ॥
1.211.m: the season, existence, dharma, adharma, and the maker of truth; / duty and non-duty to be performed, and the knowledge of dharma.

1.211.s:
yadebhirgīyate śabde ruciraṃ samayairdvijaiḥ ..
jāpyaṃ tatparamaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ devena bhānunā .. 35 ..
1.211.d:
यदेभिर्गीयते शब्दे रुचिरं समयैर्द्विजैः ॥
जाप्यं तत्परमं प्रोक्तं स्वयं देवेन भानुना ॥ 35 ॥
1.211.m: The charming song sung with these words by twice-born men observing the proper rules / was proclaimed by the god Bhānu himself as the supreme recitation.

1.211.s:
etadvai japamānastu punarāvartate na tu ..
sarvarogavinirmukto mucyate brahmahatyayā .. 36 ..
1.211.d:
एतद्वै जपमानस्तु पुनरावर्तते न तु ॥
सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तो मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया ॥ 36 ॥
1.211.m: One chanting this, indeed, does not return again; / freed from all disease, he is released from the murder of a brahmin.

1.211.s:
etajjāpyaṃ tu saṃjapya ārādhaya divākaram ..
gāyansāma tava proktaṃ śṛṇu paurāṇikaṃ suta .. 37 ..
1.211.d:
एतज्जाप्यं तु संजप्य आराधय दिवाकरम् ॥
गायन्साम तव प्रोक्तं शृणु पौराणिकं सुत ॥ 37 ॥
1.211.m: Having thoroughly recited this text, worship the Day-Maker, / singing the sāman taught to you; listen to the purāṇic text, my son.

1.211.s:
jyeṣṭhasāmno'pi te putra lakṣaṇaṃ kathayāmi hi ..
ādyāyādājyadoheti jyeṣṭhasāmopi lakṣaṇam .. 38 ..
1.211.d:
ज्येष्ठसाम्नोऽपि ते पुत्र लक्षणं कथयामि हि ॥
आद्यायादाज्यदोहेति ज्येष्ठसामोपि लक्षणम् ॥ 38 ॥
1.211.m: I shall also tell you, son, the characteristic mark of the Jyeṣṭhasāman: / starting with 'ādyāya', 'ājyadohā' is the characteristic mark of the Jyeṣṭhasāman.

1.211.s:
tava śrāvyaṃ japaṃ putrajyeṣṭhagāyai raviḥ sadā ..
samārādhaya śṛṇvanvai putrāṇāmiva putraka ..
evamārādhya deveśaṃ tato duḥkhaṃ prahāsyasi .. 39 ..
1.211.d:
तव श्राव्यं जपं पुत्रज्येष्ठगायै रविः सदा ॥
समाराधय शृण्वन्वै पुत्राणामिव पुत्रक ॥
एवमाराध्य देवेशं ततो दुःखं प्रहास्यसि ॥ 39 ॥
1.211.m: The Sun always listens to your recitation, my son, for the singer of the Jyeṣṭha [sāman]; / worship him, as he listens like a father to his sons, my boy; / having worshipped the Lord of the Gods thus, you will cast away sorrow.

1.211.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
tataḥ śrutvā piturvākyaṃ sāmagaḥ kauthumistathā .. 40 ..
1.211.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
ततः श्रुत्वा पितुर्वाक्यं सामगः कौथुमिस्तथा ॥ 40 ॥
1.211.m: Sumantu said: / Then, having heard the words of his father, the sāman-singer Kauthumi

1.211.s:
ārādhayāmāsa raviṃ bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
tataḥ śrāvyaṃ japanrājaṃtrikāle purato raveḥ .. 41 ..
1.211.d:
आराधयामास रविं भक्त्या श्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥
ततः श्राव्यं जपन्राजंत्रिकाले पुरतो रवेः ॥ 41 ॥
1.211.m: worshipped the Sun with devotion, endowed with faith, / chanting that which was to be heard three times a day before the Sun, O king.

1.211.s:
śṛṇvatastu purāṇāni bahmahatyā gatā tadā ..
vyādhiśca kuruśārdūla phalametacchrutasyavai '. 42 ..
1.211.d:
शृण्वतस्तु पुराणानि बह्महत्या गता तदा ॥
व्याधिश्च कुरुशार्दूल फलमेतच्छ्रुतस्यवै '. 42 ॥
1.211.m: As he listened to the Purāṇas, the sin of brahmin-murder departed then, / and also his disease, O tiger among the Kurus; such is the fruit of listening to it.

1.211.s:
japatā yatphalaṃ tena devaṃ pūjayatā nṛpa ..
sopi prāpto raviṃ rājañchṛṇuṣvaika manā nṛpa .. 43 ..
1.211.d:
जपता यत्फलं तेन देवं पूजयता नृप ॥
सोपि प्राप्तो रविं राजञ्छृणुष्वैक मना नृप ॥ 43 ॥
1.211.m: And the fruit obtained by him chanting and worshipping the god, O king— / he too reached the Sun, O king; listen with a single mind, O ruler of men.

1.211.s:
sa gato mūrtimānvipraḥ prasādādbhāskarasya tu ..
praviśya maṃḍalaṃ bhānoḥ padaṃ yatparamaṃ vibhoḥ .. 44 ..
1.211.d:
स गतो मूर्तिमान्विप्रः प्रसादाद्भास्करस्य तु ॥
प्रविश्य मंडलं भानोः पदं यत्परमं विभोः ॥ 44 ॥
1.211.m: That brahmin went in embodied form by the grace of the Sun; / having entered the orb of the Sun, which is the supreme abode of the Lord,

1.211.s:
āvartate na cādyāpi gatosau paramaṃ padam ..
iti te kathitaṃ rājangataḥ siddhiṃ mahādvijaḥ ..45..
1.211.d:
आवर्तते न चाद्यापि गतोसौ परमं पदम् ॥
इति ते कथितं राजन्गतः सिद्धिं महाद्विजः ॥45॥
1.211.m: he has not returned even to this day, having gone to that supreme abode. / Thus it has been told to you, O king: the great twice-born attained perfection.

1.211.s:
upoṣyemāṃ bhavedvīra saptamīṃ yāti bhāskaram ..
kauthumirnaraśārdūla prasā dādbhāskarasya tu .. 46 ..
1.211.d:
उपोष्येमां भवेद्वीर सप्तमीं याति भास्करम् ॥
कौथुमिर्नरशार्दूल प्रसा दाद्भास्करस्य तु ॥ 46 ॥
1.211.m: Fasting on this saptamī, O hero, one goes to the Sun, / as did Kauthumi, O tiger among men, by the grace of the Sun,

1.211.s:
japamānastu vai sopi purāṇaśravaṇastathā ..
ityeṣā kathitā rājanprathamā saptamī tathā .. 47 ..
1.211.d:
जपमानस्तु वै सोपि पुराणश्रवणस्तथा ॥
इत्येषा कथिता राजन्प्रथमा सप्तमी तथा ॥ 47 ॥
1.211.m: reciting it and listening to the Purāṇas. / Thus has been related, O king, the first saptamī,

1.211.s:
arkasya puṭikā puṇyā vittadā yā priyā raveḥ .. 48 .. ..
saurārcanavidhivarṇanam
1.211.d:
अर्कस्य पुटिका पुण्या वित्तदा या प्रिया रवेः ॥ 48 ॥ ॥
सौरार्चनविधिवर्णनम्
1.211.m:
the meritorious Puṭikā of the Sun, which bestows wealth and is dear to the Sun.
Description of the Rite of Solar Worship

1.212.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ityeṣā kathitā vīra arkasaṃpuṭikā tava ..
dvitīyā maricairyā tu śṛṇuṣva gadato mama .. 1 ..
1.212.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
इत्येषा कथिता वीर अर्कसंपुटिका तव ॥
द्वितीया मरिचैर्या तु शृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥ 1 ॥
1.212.m: Sumantu said: / Thus has the Arkasaṃpuṭikā been told to you, O hero; / listen as I tell of the second one, [performed] with black peppers.

1.212.s:
śuklapakṣe tu caitrasya ṣaṣṭhyāṃ samyagupoṣitaḥ ..
pūjayedbhāskaraṃ bhaktyā sauradharmavidhānataḥ .. 2 ..
1.212.d:
शुक्लपक्षे तु चैत्रस्य षष्ठ्यां सम्यगुपोषितः ॥
पूजयेद्भास्करं भक्त्या सौरधर्मविधानतः ॥ 2 ॥
1.212.m: Having fasted properly on the sixth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, / one should worship the Sun with devotion according to the ordinances of the Sauradharma.

1.212.s:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
brūhi sarvānmama brahmanmaṃtrānpuṇyānviśeṣataḥ ..
sūryādihṛdayaṃ cāpi śironyāsayutāṃstathā .. 3 ..
1.212.d:
॥ शतानीक उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रूहि सर्वान्मम ब्रह्मन्मंत्रान्पुण्यान्विशेषतः ॥
सूर्यादिहृदयं चापि शिरोन्यासयुतांस्तथा ॥ 3 ॥
1.212.m: Śatānīka said: / Speak to me, O holy one, of all the meritorious mantras in particular, / and also the heart of the Sun and the others, accompanied by the installation on the head.

1.212.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramaṃ vibho ..
yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ bhaktyā bhānormahātmanaḥ .. 4 ..
1.212.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
अहं ते कथयिष्यामि रहस्यं परमं विभो ॥
यदुक्तं ब्रह्मणा पूर्वं भक्त्या भानोर्महात्मनः ॥ 4 ॥
1.212.m: Sumantu said: / I shall tell you the supreme secret, O mighty one, / which was spoken of old by Brahmā out of devotion to the great-souled Sun,

1.212.s:
sarvapāpakṣayārthāya tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamādityaṃ lokapūji tam .. 5 ..
1.212.d:
सर्वपापक्षयार्थाय तच्छृणुष्व महामते ॥
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यमादित्यं लोकपूजि तम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.212.m: for the destruction of all sins; listen to it, O highly intelligent one. / It is meritorious, removing all sins, addressed to the Sun, and worshipped by the world.

1.212.s:
śikhādāmasamāyuktaṃ vakārāmṛtamuttamam ..
oṃ vaṃ phaṭ ..
oṃ eṣa sūryaḥ svayaṃ tāta maṃtramūrtirmahābalaḥ .. 6 ..
1.212.d:
शिखादामसमायुक्तं वकारामृतमुत्तमम् ॥
ओं वं फट् ॥
ओं एष सूर्यः स्वयं तात मंत्रमूर्तिर्महाबलः ॥ 6 ॥
1.212.m: Joined with a crest garland, the excellent nectar consisting of the syllable 'va': / 'oṃ vaṃ phaṭ' / Oṃ, this is the Sun himself, father, an embodiment of the mantra, possessed of great power.

1.212.s:
asyānusmaraṇānmaṃtrī nityaṃ madhurabhojanaḥ ..
saṃvatsareṇa deveśaṃ sākṣādbhānuṃ prapaśyati .. 7 ..
1.212.d:
अस्यानुस्मरणान्मंत्री नित्यं मधुरभोजनः ॥
संवत्सरेण देवेशं साक्षाद्भानुं प्रपश्यति ॥ 7 ॥
1.212.m: By constantly remembering this, the mantra-practitioner eating sweet food / directly sees the Lord of the Gods, the Sun, within a year.

1.212.s:
vyādhimṛtyośca nirmuktaḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati ..
satataṃ japamānastu rājanmaṃtravidāṃ varaḥ .. 8 ..
1.212.d:
व्याधिमृत्योश्च निर्मुक्तः सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति ॥
सततं जपमानस्तु राजन्मंत्रविदां वरः ॥ 8 ॥
1.212.m: Freed from disease and death, he goes to the world of the Sun; / constantly reciting it, O king, the best of knowers of mantras,

1.212.s:
manasā karmaṇā vācā śāpānugrahatopi vā ..
kṣīrāśī maunamāśritya vivikte niyatendriyaḥ .. 9 ..
1.212.d:
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा शापानुग्रहतोपि वा ॥
क्षीराशी मौनमाश्रित्य विविक्ते नियतेन्द्रियः ॥ 9 ॥
1.212.m: whether through curse or favor in thought, word, or deed; / subsisting on milk, taking refuge in silence, in solitude, with controlled senses,

1.212.s:
japitvā dvādaśalakṣaṃ saśarīro divaṃ vrajet ..
trailokyaṃ carate rājaṃściṃtāmaṇirivecchayā .. 1.212.10 ..
1.212.d:
जपित्वा द्वादशलक्षं सशरीरो दिवं व्रजेत् ॥
त्रैलोक्यं चरते राजंश्चिंतामणिरिवेच्छया ॥ 1.212.10 ॥
1.212.m: having chanted it twelve hundred thousand times, he goes to heaven with his body; / he traverses the three worlds at will like a wish-fulfilling jewel, O king.

1.212.s:
athedaṃ paramaṃ vāmaṃ sūryasya hṛdayaṃ śṛṇu ..
smartavyaṃ śucinā nityaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpa ham .. 11 ..
1.212.d:
अथेदं परमं वामं सूर्यस्य हृदयं शृणु ॥
स्मर्तव्यं शुचिना नित्यं सर्वपापभयाप हम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.212.m: Now hear this supreme, auspicious Heart of the Sun, / which should be remembered daily by a pure person, dispelling all sins and fears.

1.212.s:
viyuktaṃ caṃdrasaṃyuktamṛkāreṇa ca bhārata ..
oṃkāradīpitaṃ caiva hṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam .. 12 ..
1.212.d:
वियुक्तं चंद्रसंयुक्तमृकारेण च भारत ॥
ओंकारदीपितं चैव हृदयं परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.212.m: Free of consonants and joined with the moon, and with the letter 'ṛ', O descendant of Bharata, / and illuminated by the syllable Oṃ: thus is the Heart proclaimed.

1.212.s:
yakārabiṃdusaṃyuktaṃ vaiśākhaḥ kathito budhaiḥ..
yakāraśca vakāraśca mātrā biṃdustathā nṛpa ..13..
1.212.d:
यकारबिंदुसंयुक्तं वैशाखः कथितो बुधैः॥
यकारश्च वकारश्च मात्रा बिंदुस्तथा नृप ॥13॥
1.212.m: Joined with the letter 'ya' and the bindu, it is declared by the wise as Vaiśākha; / and the letter 'ya', the letter 'va', the vowel measure, and the bindu, O king.

1.212.s:
iṣṭaṃ kavacamādiṣṭamastraṃ vakṣye nibodha me ..
praṇavādiṃ dukāraṃ ca sānusvāraṃ kaṭastathā .. 14 ..
1.212.d:
इष्टं कवचमादिष्टमस्त्रं वक्ष्ये निबोध मे ॥
प्रणवादिं दुकारं च सानुस्वारं कटस्तथा ॥ 14 ॥
1.212.m:
The desired armour has been taught; hear from me the weapon [mantra] which I shall explain:
Beginning with Praṇava, the syllable du along with the anusvāra, and then kaṭa.

1.212.s:
idamastraṃ smṛtaṃ rājannamṛtaṃ ca nibodha me ..
biṃducaṃdrasamāyuktaṃ vakāramamṛtaṃ smṛtam ..15..
1.212.d:
इदमस्त्रं स्मृतं राजन्नमृतं च निबोध मे ॥
बिंदुचंद्रसमायुक्तं वकारममृतं स्मृतम् ॥15॥
1.212.m:
This is known as the weapon [mantra], O king; and learn from me the nectar [mantra]:
The syllable va joined with the bindu and crescent moon is considered the nectar.

1.212.s:
oṃ brahmannastramamṛtaṃ gāyatrīṃ cāpi te rogaṃ dhenurvai parikīrtitam..
yakāraśca vakāraśca rirovetramādiśet ..16..
1.212.d:
ओं ब्रह्मन्नस्त्रममृतं गायत्रीं चापि ते रोगं धेनुर्वै परिकीर्तितम्॥
यकारश्च वकारश्च रिरोवेत्रमादिशेत् ॥16॥
1.212.m:
"Oṃ, O Brahman, the weapon, the nectar, and the gāyatrī, [expelling] your disease; the dhenu [mudrā] is proclaimed;
and the syllable ya and the syllable va; one should designate the staff of protection.

1.212.s:
vyanetra etānyaṃgāni sūryasyāmitatejasaḥ ..
ādityaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyaset..17..
1.212.d:
व्यनेत्र एतान्यंगानि सूर्यस्यामिततेजसः ॥
आदित्यं मूर्ध्नि विन्यस्य हृदये हृदयं न्यसेत्॥17॥
1.212.m:
These limbs belong to Sūrya of limitless radiance.
Having installed Āditya on the crown of the head, one should install the heart [mantra] in the heart.

1.212.s:
sāvitrīṃ kaṃṭhadeśe tu aśeṣaṃ mūrdhni ciṃtayet ..
arkanyāso mayākhyāto vidvānnyāsaṃ prakalpayet ..18..
1.212.d:
सावित्रीं कंठदेशे तु अशेषं मूर्ध्नि चिंतयेत् ॥
अर्कन्यासो मयाख्यातो विद्वान्न्यासं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥18॥
1.212.m:
One should meditate on Sāvitrī in the region of the throat, and the remainder on the crown of the head.
The installation of Arka has been spoken by me; the wise man should perform the installation.

1.212.s:
ekākṣarasya sūryasya śṛṇvarcanavidhiṃ param ..
prathamaṃ kiṃkiṇīmudrāṃ baddhvā tu hṛdaye nṛpa .. 10 ..
1.212.d:
एकाक्षरस्य सूर्यस्य शृण्वर्चनविधिं परम् ॥
प्रथमं किंकिणीमुद्रां बद्ध्वा तु हृदये नृप ॥ 10 ॥
1.212.m:
Hear the supreme procedure for worship of the single-syllabled Sūrya:
First having formed the kiṅkiṇī-mudrā at the heart, O king,

1.212.s:
prāṇāyāme ca tathā parivīrasamanvitam ..
ekākṣaraṃ samāvetti ātmaśuddhyarthamādarāt .. 1.212.20 ..
1.212.d:
प्राणायामे च तथा परिवीरसमन्वितम् ॥
एकाक्षरं समावेत्ति आत्मशुद्ध्यर्थमादरात् ॥ 1.212.20 ॥
1.212.m:
and likewise in breath-control, accompanied by the retinue,
one should repeat the single syllable with care for the purification of the self.

1.212.s: punastvāmeva vadhyaṃ tu vakāreṇātmanā labhet .. 21 ..
1.212.d: पुनस्त्वामेव वध्यं तु वकारेणात्मना लभेत् ॥ 21 ॥
1.212.m: Then, through the syllable va, one should obtain oneself as one to be bound.

1.212.s:
etatkṛtvādityasamo bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ ..
kṛtvā ca mudrāṃ prāsāde astraṃ yojya mahīpate .. 22 ..
1.212.d:
एतत्कृत्वादित्यसमो भवतीति न संशयः ॥
कृत्वा च मुद्रां प्रासादे अस्त्रं योज्य महीपते ॥ 22 ॥
1.212.m:
Having done this, one becomes equal to Āditya, there is no doubt.
Having formed the mudrā in the temple and applied the weapon [mantra], O lord of the earth,

1.212.s:
prāsādaśobhanaṃ syādvai kṛtvā tadbharatarṣabha ..
kavacenārkavāñchatruṃ kṣālayedvardhanakriyām .. 23 ..
1.212.d:
प्रासादशोभनं स्याद्वै कृत्वा तद्भरतर्षभ ॥
कवचेनार्कवाञ्छत्रुं क्षालयेद्वर्धनक्रियाम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.212.m:
the beautification of the temple will take place, O bull of the Bharatas.
With the armour [mantra] one should wash away the hostile force, performing the rite of prosperity.

1.212.s:
tatorghyapātraṃ puṣpaiśca pūjayedvidhivanṛpa ..
hṛdinā snāpayeddevaṃ tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret .. 24 ..
1.212.d:
ततोर्घ्यपात्रं पुष्पैश्च पूजयेद्विधिवनृप ॥
हृदिना स्नापयेद्देवं ततः पूजां समाचरेत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.212.m:
Then, O king, one should properly worship the vessel of respectful offering with flowers.
One should bathe the god with the heart [mantra], and then perform worship.

1.212.s:
padmamudrā puṣpagarbhā devaṃ śirasi vinyaset ..
āvāhito bhavedevaṃ devadevo divākaraḥ .. 25 ..
1.212.d:
पद्ममुद्रा पुष्पगर्भा देवं शिरसि विन्यसेत् ॥
आवाहितो भवेदेवं देवदेवो दिवाकरः ॥ 25 ॥
1.212.m:
With the lotus-mudrā containing flowers, one should place [them] on the head of the god.
In this way the god of gods, the maker of day, becomes invoked.

1.212.s:
hṛdayenārghyasaṃyuktāṃ pūjāṃ badhnīta bhārata ..
hṛdayena ca naivedyaṃ dātavyaṃ śaktito vibhoḥ .. 26 ..
1.212.d:
हृदयेनार्घ्यसंयुक्तां पूजां बध्नीत भारत ॥
हृदयेन च नैवेद्यं दातव्यं शक्तितो विभोः ॥ 26 ॥
1.212.m:
One should perform the worship accompanied by the respectful offering with the heart [mantra], O descendant of Bharata;
and food offerings should be given to the all-pervading lord according to one's ability with the heart [mantra].

1.212.s:
yathāśakti japaṃ kuryātsuvratī vāgyatendriyaḥ ..
anena vidhinā rājansarvakā ryāṇi sādhayet .. 27 ..
1.212.d:
यथाशक्ति जपं कुर्यात्सुव्रती वाग्यतेन्द्रियः ॥
अनेन विधिना राजन्सर्वका र्याणि साधयेत् ॥ 27 ॥
1.212.m:
Faithful to vows, with speech and senses restrained, one should perform recitation according to one's ability.
By this procedure, O king, one should accomplish all undertakings.

1.212.s:
na kvacitpratighātaḥ syānna cāpi duritaṃ bhavet ..
vyomamudrāṃ parāṃ baddhvā kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam .. 28 ..
1.212.d:
न क्वचित्प्रतिघातः स्यान्न चापि दुरितं भवेत् ॥
व्योममुद्रां परां बद्ध्वा कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.212.m:
Nowhere will there be any obstacle, nor will there be misfortune.
Having formed the supreme vyoma-mudrā and performed circumambulation,

1.212.s:
devaṃ visarjayetpaścāddhṛdayena mahīpate .. 29 ..
saurārcanavidhivarṇanam
1.212.d:
देवं विसर्जयेत्पश्चाद्धृदयेन महीपते ॥ 29 ॥
सौरार्चनविधिवर्णनम्
1.212.m:
one should afterwards dismiss the god with the heart [mantra], O lord of the earth.
Description of the procedure for solar worship.

1.213.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
dṛṣṭvā tu pāvakaṃ devaṃ pāvakasthaṃ divākaram ..
avyāttu saparīvāraṃ ghukāraṃ parikīrtayet .. .. 1 ..
1.213.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
दृष्ट्वा तु पावकं देवं पावकस्थं दिवाकरम् ॥
अव्यात्तु सपरीवारं घुकारं परिकीर्तयेत् ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
1.213.m:
Sumantu said:
Having seen the divine Fire and the Maker of Day situated in the fire,
he should proclaim the syllable ghu with his retinue, and it shall protect [him].

1.213.s:
evaṃ kṛte śodhanaṃ syātpāvakasya na saṃśayaḥ ..
padmagarbhe tato vātha hṛdayāgnau samākṣipet .. 2 ..
1.213.d:
एवं कृते शोधनं स्यात्पावकस्य न संशयः ॥
पद्मगर्भे ततो वाथ हृदयाग्नौ समाक्षिपेत् ॥ 2 ॥
1.213.m:
When this is done, there will be purification of the fire, there is no doubt.
Then one should cast it into the interior of a lotus, or else into the fire of the heart.

1.213.s:
āvāhito bhaveddevadevaḥ sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ ..
oṃkāreṇāhutiśataṃ netrāṃjanasamādhinā .. 3 ..
1.213.d:
आवाहितो भवेद्देवदेवः साक्षान्न संशयः ॥
ओंकारेणाहुतिशतं नेत्रांजनसमाधिना ॥ 3 ॥
1.213.m:
The god of gods will be manifestly invoked, there is no doubt.
With the oṃ-kāra, [one should offer] a hundred oblations with absorption of mind [like] collyrium to the eyes.

1.213.s:
pañcāhutīstato dadyādaṃgānāṃ prītaye nṛpa ..
visarjanaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhṛdayena vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4 ..
maricasaptamīvratavarṇanam
1.213.d:
पञ्चाहुतीस्ततो दद्यादंगानां प्रीतये नृप ॥
विसर्जनं ततः कुर्याद्धृदयेन विचक्षणः ॥ 4 ॥
मरिचसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
1.213.m:
Then one should give five oblations for the gratification of the limbs, O king.
The wise man should then perform the dismissal with the heart [mantra].
Description of the Marīcisaptamī observance.

1.214.s:
.. sumantu ruvāca .. ..
padminī ca tathānyā tu madhyamānāmanī tathā ..
arkiṇī jvālinī caiva tejanī ca gabhastinī .. 1 ..
1.214.d:
॥ सुमन्तु रुवाच ॥ ॥
पद्मिनी च तथान्या तु मध्यमानामनी तथा ॥
अर्किणी ज्वालिनी चैव तेजनी च गभस्तिनी ॥ 1 ॥

1.214.s:
śaṃkhamudrā ca daśamī sūrya vaktrā tathāparā ..
sahasrakiraṇā caiva mudrā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ .. 2..
1.214.d:
शंखमुद्रा च दशमी सूर्य वक्त्रा तथापरा ॥
सहस्रकिरणा चैव मुद्रा द्वादश कीर्तिताः ॥ 2॥
1.214.m:
Śaṅkhamudrā as the tenth, Sūryavaktrā as another,
and Sahasrakiraṇā: twelve mudrās are proclaimed.

1.214.s:
dadyādarghyaṃ tu padminyā vyoma baddhā japedbudhaḥ ..
udayāśrayaḥ samākarṣe madhyamā vyādhināśinī .. 3 ..
1.214.d:
दद्यादर्घ्यं तु पद्मिन्या व्योम बद्धा जपेद्बुधः ॥
उदयाश्रयः समाकर्षे मध्यमा व्याधिनाशिनी ॥ 3 ॥
1.214.m:
The wise man should offer the respectful offering with Padminī, and recite having formed Vyomā.
Udayāśraya is for drawing near, and Madhyamā is the destroyer of diseases.

1.214.s:
arkiṇyā paśyate sūryaṃ vidhisthastu bhavedyadi ..
jvālinīmupasaṃgaṃtuṃ baddhvā sūryamukho japet .. 4 ..
1.214.d:
अर्किण्या पश्यते सूर्यं विधिस्थस्तु भवेद्यदि ॥
ज्वालिनीमुपसंगंतुं बद्ध्वा सूर्यमुखो जपेत् ॥ 4 ॥
1.214.m:
With Arkiṇī, if one abides by the rule, one beholds Sūrya.
Having formed Jvālinī in order to draw near, facing Sūrya, one should recite.

1.214.s:
saptāhādvīkṣate sūryaṃ sidhyate ca tataḥ svayam ..
avatīrya padmakhaṃḍaṃ sūryādabhimukho naraḥ .. 5 ..
1.214.d:
सप्ताहाद्वीक्षते सूर्यं सिध्यते च ततः स्वयम् ॥
अवतीर्य पद्मखंडं सूर्यादभिमुखो नरः ॥ 5 ॥
1.214.m:
After seven days one beholds Sūrya, and then accomplishes [the goal] of oneself.
A man who enters a cluster of lotuses facing Sūrya,

1.214.s:
japañchatasahasraṃ hi akṣayaṃ labhate nidhim ..
śaṃkhamudrādibhirimaṃ sūrya cakravidhiṃ śṛṇu .. 6 ..
1.214.d:
जपञ्छतसहस्रं हि अक्षयं लभते निधिम् ॥
शंखमुद्रादिभिरिमं सूर्य चक्रविधिं शृणु ॥ 6 ॥
1.214.m:
reciting one hundred thousand times, indeed obtains an inexhaustible treasure.
Hear this procedure of Sūrya's circle beginning with the śaṅkha-mudrā.

1.214.s:
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā baddhvā sūryamukho naraḥ ..
sthitaḥ padmāsane rājañjapaṃścāpyayutaṃ manum .. 7 ..
1.214.d:
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा बद्ध्वा सूर्यमुखो नरः ॥
स्थितः पद्मासने राजञ्जपंश्चाप्ययुतं मनुम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.214.m:
Having fasted for a day and night, forming [the mudrā], facing Sūrya,
seated in the lotus posture, O king, and reciting the mantra ten thousand times,

1.214.s:
paśyate tu tryahātsūryaṃ bhavetsiddhiśca mānasī ..
sahasrakiraṇaṃ baddhvā nābhimātrajale sthitaḥ .. 8 ..
1.214.d:
पश्यते तु त्र्यहात्सूर्यं भवेत्सिद्धिश्च मानसी ॥
सहस्रकिरणं बद्ध्वा नाभिमात्रजले स्थितः ॥ 8 ॥
1.214.m:
one beholds Sūrya in three days, and mental accomplishment arises.
Having formed Sahasrakiraṇa, standing in water up to the navel,

1.214.s:
japedayutamātraṃ tu bhavettadgatamānasaḥ ..
sahasrakiraṇaṃ devaṃ paraṃ raśmibhirāvṛtam.. .. 9 ..
1.214.d:
जपेदयुतमात्रं तु भवेत्तद्गतमानसः ॥
सहस्रकिरणं देवं परं रश्मिभिरावृतम्॥ ॥ 9 ॥
1.214.m:
one should recite just ten thousand times, with one's mind focused on that.
The thousand-rayed supreme god, covered by beams of light—

1.214.s:
sa paśyati paraṃ dhāma bhavetsiddhiśca puṣkalā ..
śāpānugrahakartāsau sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhavet .. 1.214.10 ..
1.214.d:
स पश्यति परं धाम भवेत्सिद्धिश्च पुष्कला ॥
शापानुग्रहकर्तासौ सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भवेत् ॥ 1.214.10 ॥
1.214.m:
he beholds that supreme abode, and abundant accomplishment arises.
He becomes a bestower of curses and blessings upon all living beings.

1.214.s: sarvataḥ kañcukaṃ muktvā bhavedvai vigata jvaraḥ .. 11 ..
1.214.d: सर्वतः कञ्चुकं मुक्त्वा भवेद्वै विगत ज्वरः ॥ 11 ॥
1.214.m: Casting off the cuirass on all sides, he becomes indeed free from fever.

1.214.s:
parau gulphau karau kṛtvā saṃlagnau ca parasparam ..
vāmānāmikayākramya dakṣiṇāṃ tu kanīyasīm .. 12 ..
1.214.d:
परौ गुल्फौ करौ कृत्वा संलग्नौ च परस्परम् ॥
वामानामिकयाक्रम्य दक्षिणां तु कनीयसीम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.214.m:
Having made the hands like outer ankles and joined to one another,
having crossed the right little finger with the left ring finger,

1.214.s:
vāmā dakṣiṇayā caiva dakṣiṇā vāmayā tathā ..
mudraiṣā hi mahāpuṇyā vyomamudrā prakīrtitā .. 13 ..
1.214.d:
वामा दक्षिणया चैव दक्षिणा वामया तथा ॥
मुद्रैषा हि महापुण्या व्योममुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 13 ॥
1.214.m:
the left by the right, and likewise the right by the left:
this very auspicious mudrā is proclaimed as the vyoma-mudrā.

1.214.s:
baddhayā cānayā sadyo hīyaṃte vyādhayo nṛṇām ..
nānayā rahitaḥ kaścitsiddhiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ .. 14 ..
1.214.d:
बद्धया चानया सद्यो हीयंते व्याधयो नृणाम् ॥
नानया रहितः कश्चित्सिद्धिं प्राप्नोति साधकः ॥ 14 ॥
1.214.m:
When this is formed, diseases of men are instantly destroyed.
No practitioner destitute of this attains accomplishment.

1.214.s:
sarvatraivottamā hyeṣā maṃtramuṣṭiriti smṛtā ..
sūryasya hṛdayaṃ seyamarkamudreti viśrutā .. 15 ..
1.214.d:
सर्वत्रैवोत्तमा ह्येषा मंत्रमुष्टिरिति स्मृता ॥
सूर्यस्य हृदयं सेयमर्कमुद्रेति विश्रुता ॥ 15 ॥
1.214.m:
This is celebrated everywhere as supreme, the clenched fist of mantras;
this is Sūrya's heart, renowned as the arka-mudrā.

1.214.s:
badhnīyātsatataṃ mantrairāyurārogyavṛddhaye ..
sūryamaṃḍala abhyagre mantrī sūryodaye sthitaḥ .. 16 ..
1.214.d:
बध्नीयात्सततं मन्त्रैरायुरारोग्यवृद्धये ॥
सूर्यमंडल अभ्यग्रे मन्त्री सूर्योदये स्थितः ॥ 16 ॥
1.214.m:
One should always form it with mantras for the increase of life and health.
Standing at the front of Sūrya's orb at sunrise, the practitioner of mantras,

1.214.s:
sa sūryābhimukho bhūtvā japenmaṃtraṃ tu sādhakaḥ ..
dinatrayeṇa vīkṣeta dhyānī japaparāyaṇaḥ .. 17 ..
1.214.d:
स सूर्याभिमुखो भूत्वा जपेन्मंत्रं तु साधकः ॥
दिनत्रयेण वीक्षेत ध्यानी जपपरायणः ॥ 17 ॥
1.214.m:
facing Sūrya, the practitioner should recite the mantra.
Absorbed in meditation and dedicated to recitation, one would behold [him] in three days.

1.214.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāśnute mṛtyuṃ duḥkhī na ca na saṃśayaḥ ..
prāpnoti ca paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ .. 18 ..
1.214.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा नाश्नुते मृत्युं दुःखी न च न संशयः ॥
प्राप्नोति च परं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः ॥ 18 ॥
1.214.m:
Having seen him, one does not suffer death, nor does one become sorrowful, there is no doubt;
and one attains the supreme abode where the divine Maker of Day resides.

1.214.s:
uttānau tu karau kṛtvā pṛṣṭhalagnau parasparam ..
baddhvā tvaṃgulayaḥ sarvāḥ suprakīrṇā na saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
1.214.d:
उत्तानौ तु करौ कृत्वा पृष्ठलग्नौ परस्परम् ॥
बद्ध्वा त्वंगुलयः सर्वाः सुप्रकीर्णा न संशयः ॥ 19 ॥
1.214.m:
Having made the hands face upwards, with the backs joined to each other,
and all the fingers bound and well-extended, there is no doubt,

1.214.s:
ākramya cāṃgulīmūlamaṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ yathākramam ..
udayā nāma mudraiṣā badhnīyādudaye raveḥ .. 1.214.20 ..
1.214.d:
आक्रम्य चांगुलीमूलमंगुष्ठाभ्यां यथाक्रमम् ॥
उदया नाम मुद्रैषा बध्नीयादुदये रवेः ॥ 1.214.20 ॥
1.214.m:
and having pressed the root of the fingers with the thumbs in due order:
this mudrā is named Udayā; one should form it at the rising of Ravi.

1.214.s:
dvādaśādvīkṣate sūryaṃ dinātsa hi na saṃśayaḥ ..
sarvapāpaharā caiva sarvapāpavināśinī .. 21 ..
1.214.d:
द्वादशाद्वीक्षते सूर्यं दिनात्स हि न संशयः ॥
सर्वपापहरा चैव सर्वपापविनाशिनी ॥ 21 ॥
1.214.m:
From the twelfth day, he indeed beholds Sūrya, there is no doubt.
It removes all sins and destroys all sins.

1.214.s:
udayā ca vinā vāmaṃ madhyataścaiva taṃ kṣipet ..
madhyamā nāma vikhyātā madhyasūrye tu cintayet .. 22 ..
1.214.d:
उदया च विना वामं मध्यतश्चैव तं क्षिपेत् ॥
मध्यमा नाम विख्याता मध्यसूर्ये तु चिन्तयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
1.214.m:
Without the left hand of Udayā, one should place it in the middle:
it is renowned as Madhyamā, and one should meditate on it when Sūrya is at noon.

1.214.s:
madhyamā vidhinā tena baddhvā mudrāṃ tu sādhakaḥ ..
aṃgulyoḥ paramaṃguṣṭhau vidhinā tāvubhau grathet .. 23 ..
1.214.d:
मध्यमा विधिना तेन बद्ध्वा मुद्रां तु साधकः ॥
अंगुल्योः परमंगुष्ठौ विधिना तावुभौ ग्रथेत् ॥ 23 ॥
1.214.m: When the practitioner has formed the madhyamā mudrā according to that rule, / he should properly interlace the two highest thumbs of both fingers.

1.214.s:
mudrā sāstamanī hyeṣā sarvatantreśvarī śubhā ..
sūryasyāstamane mudrā baddhvā japtaṃ samārabhet .. 24 ..
1.214.d:
मुद्रा सास्तमनी ह्येषा सर्वतन्त्रेश्वरी शुभा ॥
सूर्यस्यास्तमने मुद्रा बद्ध्वा जप्तं समारभेत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.214.m: This is indeed the astamanī mudrā, the auspicious sovereign over all tantras; / having formed this mudrā at the setting of the sun, he should begin his recitation.

1.214.s:
sahasraṃ hi śataṃ vāpi mudrāṃ baddhvā japedbudhaḥ ..
sarvapātakasaṃyuktaḥ saptāhādanuśobhanam .. 25 ..
1.214.d:
सहस्रं हि शतं वापि मुद्रां बद्ध्वा जपेद्बुधः ॥
सर्वपातकसंयुक्तः सप्ताहादनुशोभनम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.214.m: Having formed the mudrā, the wise man should recite [the mantra] a thousand or a hundred [times]; / even if tainted with all sins, he will become radiant after seven days.

1.214.s:
karau parasparaṃ lagnāvaṃguṣṭhau cordhvasaṃsthitau ..
ubhau cāṃguṣṭhakau cordhvau saṃlagnau mūrdhni saṃsthitau .. 26 ..
1.214.d:
करौ परस्परं लग्नावंगुष्ठौ चोर्ध्वसंस्थितौ ॥
उभौ चांगुष्ठकौ चोर्ध्वौ संलग्नौ मूर्ध्नि संस्थितौ ॥ 26 ॥
1.214.m: The two hands joined to each other, with the two thumbs held upright, / and both thumbs joined and held upright, positioned upon the head—

1.214.s:
mudrā nu mālinī caiva nirdahetpāpapañjaram ..
brahmahatyādi yatpāpaṃ yojitā sā tu mūrdhani .. 27 ..
1.214.d:
मुद्रा नु मालिनी चैव निर्दहेत्पापपञ्जरम् ॥
ब्रह्महत्यादि यत्पापं योजिता सा तु मूर्धनि ॥ 27 ॥
1.214.m: this is indeed the mālinī mudrā; placed on the crown of the head, / it burns away the cage of sins, such sins as the murder of a Brahmin.

1.214.s:
vidarbhyāṃgulayaḥ sarvā īṣanmadhyastathāgrataḥ ..
ūrdhvasthitau taṣāṃguṣṭhau mudreyaṃ tarjanī smṛtā .. 28 ..
1.214.d:
विदर्भ्यांगुलयः सर्वा ईषन्मध्यस्तथाग्रतः ॥
ऊर्ध्वस्थितौ तषांगुष्ठौ मुद्रेयं तर्जनी स्मृता ॥ 28 ॥
1.214.m: All the fingers being curved, slightly intermediate, and pointing forward, / with the two thumbs held upright—this mudrā is known as tarjanī.

1.214.s:
sarvavyādhiharā devī sarva śatruvināśinī ..
etāṃ baddhvā mahāpuṇyāṃ sarvānstaṃmbhayate ripūn .. 29 ..
1.214.d:
सर्वव्याधिहरा देवी सर्व शत्रुविनाशिनी ॥
एतां बद्ध्वा महापुण्यां सर्वान्स्तंम्भयते रिपून् ॥ 29 ॥
1.214.m: It is a goddess that removes all diseases and destroys all enemies; / having formed this highly meritorious [mudrā], he paralyses all foes.

1.214.s:
ubhau prasārya vai hastau madhye sārdhena saṃsthitau ..
śeṣānāmyā tataścaiva aṃguṣṭhāgraṃ tathā kramāt .. 1.214.30 ..
1.214.d:
उभौ प्रसार्य वै हस्तौ मध्ये सार्धेन संस्थितौ ॥
शेषानाम्या ततश्चैव अंगुष्ठाग्रं तथा क्रमात् ॥ 1.214.30 ॥
1.214.m: Having extended both hands, positioned midway with the half, / having bent the remaining ones, and likewise the tip of the thumb in due order—

1.214.s:
mudrā gabhastinī nāma sūryasya hṛdayaṃ param ..
mṛtyuṃ nāśayate hyeṣā baddhvā sūryodaye śubhā ..31..
1.214.d:
मुद्रा गभस्तिनी नाम सूर्यस्य हृदयं परम् ॥
मृत्युं नाशयते ह्येषा बद्ध्वा सूर्योदये शुभा ॥31॥
1.214.m: this is the mudrā named gabhastinī, the supreme heart of the Sun; / formed at sunrise, this auspicious [mudrā] destroys death.

1.214.s:
arghyakāle tu badhnīyādarcayāgniṃ prapūjayet ..
japakāle ca badhnīyānmaṃtrāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 32 ..
1.214.d:
अर्घ्यकाले तु बध्नीयादर्चयाग्निं प्रपूजयेत् ॥
जपकाले च बध्नीयान्मंत्राणां नात्र संशयः ॥ 32 ॥
1.214.m: He should form it at the time of the water-offering, and worship the fire with adoration; / and he should form it at the time of reciting mantras—of this there is no doubt.

1.214.s:
vidakṣiṇakaniṣṭhikyāṃ tarjanībhyāṃ tathā bhavet ..
tarjanībhyāṃ tathāṃguṣṭhau saṃlagnau tu parasparam ..
japaṃ yaḥ kurute nityaṃ tribhirmāsairviśudyati .. 33 ..
1.214.d:
विदक्षिणकनिष्ठिक्यां तर्जनीभ्यां तथा भवेत् ॥
तर्जनीभ्यां तथांगुष्ठौ संलग्नौ तु परस्परम् ॥
जपं यः कुरुते नित्यं त्रिभिर्मासैर्विशुद्यति ॥ 33 ॥
1.214.m: With the right little finger and likewise the forefingers, / and with the thumbs joined to each other through the forefingers— / he who daily performs recitation [thus] is purified in three months.

1.214.s: karau tu saṃpuṭau kṛtvā tarjanyau dve ca kuñcayet ..34..
1.214.d: करौ तु संपुटौ कृत्वा तर्जन्यौ द्वे च कुञ्चयेत् ॥34॥
1.214.m: Having cupped the hands, he should contract the two forefingers.

1.214.s:
sahasrakiraṇā hyeṣā sarvamudreśvareśvarī ..
trisaṃdhyametāṃ badhnīyātsādhako maṃtramūrdhani ..
nāśayetsarvapāpāni tamorāśimivāṃśumān .. 35 ..
1.214.d:
सहस्रकिरणा ह्येषा सर्वमुद्रेश्वरेश्वरी ॥
त्रिसंध्यमेतां बध्नीयात्साधको मंत्रमूर्धनि ॥
नाशयेत्सर्वपापानि तमोराशिमिवांशुमान् ॥ 35 ॥
1.214.m: This is the sahasrakiraṇā, the sovereign over the masters of all mudrās; / the practitioner should form this at the three junctions of the day above the mantra; / it destroys all sins just as the sun destroys a mass of darkness.

1.214.s:
mudrā mudrakakuṃbheti baddhvā paścāttu maṃtrayet ..
māsena nāśayetkuṣṭhaṃ tribhirmāsairna saṃśayaḥ ..
iti mudrāṃgasahitaṃ sūryaṃ pūjayate tu yaḥ .. 36 ..
1.214.d:
मुद्रा मुद्रककुंभेति बद्ध्वा पश्चात्तु मंत्रयेत् ॥
मासेन नाशयेत्कुष्ठं त्रिभिर्मासैर्न संशयः ॥
इति मुद्रांगसहितं सूर्यं पूजयते तु यः ॥ 36 ॥
1.214.m: Having formed the mudrā called mudrakakumbhā, he should subsequently recite the mantra; / it destroys leprosy in one month, or within three months without a doubt. / Thus, he who worships the Sun along with the subsidiary mudrās—

1.214.s:
anena vidhinā rājanbrahmā pūjayate ravim ..
tasmāttvamapi rājeṃdra pūjayānena bhāskaram .. 37 ..
1.214.d:
अनेन विधिना राजन्ब्रह्मा पूजयते रविम् ॥
तस्मात्त्वमपि राजेंद्र पूजयानेन भास्करम् ॥ 37 ॥
1.214.m: by this procedure, O king, Brahmā worships the Sun; / therefore, you too, O chief of kings, worship the Sun with this [procedure].

1.214.s:
tataḥ sūryamavāpyeha sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati ..
anena vidhinā yastu pūjayetsata taṃ ravim .. 38 ..
1.214.d:
ततः सूर्यमवाप्येह सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति ॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु पूजयेत्सत तं रविम् ॥ 38 ॥
1.214.m: Then, having attained the Sun here, he goes to the world of the Sun; / he who constantly worships the Sun by this procedure,

1.214.s:
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ ..
itthaṃ pūjya ca deveśamanena vidhinā nṛpa .. 39 ..
1.214.d:
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः ॥
इत्थं पूज्य च देवेशमनेन विधिना नृप ॥ 39 ॥
1.214.m: he goes to the supreme abode where the divine Sun resides. / Having thus worshipped the Lord of gods by this procedure, O king,

1.214.s:
bhojayitvā yathāśakti brāhmaṇāṃśca vidhānataḥ ..
saptamyāṃ prāśayedvāpi maricaṃ maṃtratastathā .. 1.214.40 ..
1.214.d:
भोजयित्वा यथाशक्ति ब्राह्मणांश्च विधानतः ॥
सप्तम्यां प्राशयेद्वापि मरिचं मंत्रतस्तथा ॥ 1.214.40 ॥
1.214.m: and having fed Brahmins according to rule to the best of his ability, / he should also consume black pepper on the saptamī with mantra.

1.214.s:
ekaṃ gṛhītvā maricamavraṇaṃ ca dṛḍhaṃ param ..
sajalaṃ prāśayedrājanmantreṇānena vā smṛtam .. 41 ..
1.214.d:
एकं गृहीत्वा मरिचमव्रणं च दृढं परम् ॥
सजलं प्राशयेद्राजन्मन्त्रेणानेन वा स्मृतम् ॥ 41 ॥
1.214.m: Taking a single peppercorn that is unblemished and exceedingly firm, / he should consume it with water, O king, or as prescribed with this mantra.

1.214.s:
yathoktena vidhānena pūjayitvā divākaram..
iti saṃprāśya maricaṃ tato bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ ..42..
1.214.d:
यथोक्तेन विधानेन पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम्॥
इति संप्राश्य मरिचं ततो भुंजीत वाग्यतः ॥42॥
1.214.m: Having worshipped the Sun according to the prescribed procedure, / and having thus consumed the peppercorn, he should then eat with restrained speech.

1.214.s:
priyasaṃgamavāpnoti tatkṣaṇādeva nānyathā ..
itīyaṃ saptamī puṇyā priyasaṃgamadāyinī .. 43 ..
1.214.d:
प्रियसंगमवाप्नोति तत्क्षणादेव नान्यथा ॥
इतीयं सप्तमी पुण्या प्रियसंगमदायिनी ॥ 43 ॥
1.214.m: He attains union with his beloved at that very moment, not otherwise; / thus this holy saptamī grants union with the beloved.

1.214.s:
kuryādekena kāmāṃstu vatsareṇa sa gacchati ..
putrādibhirnaraśreṣṭha punaḥ saṃgamamṛcchati .. 44 ..
1.214.d:
कुर्यादेकेन कामांस्तु वत्सरेण स गच्छति ॥
पुत्रादिभिर्नरश्रेष्ठ पुनः संगममृच्छति ॥ 44 ॥
1.214.m: He achieves his desires within one year and departs; / he attains reunion with his sons and others, O best of men.

1.214.s:
kuru tasmānmahābāho tvameva priyadāyinīm ..
upoṣya iṃdro vidhivatsurāmaricasaptamīm .. 45 ..
1.214.d:
कुरु तस्मान्महाबाहो त्वमेव प्रियदायिनीम् ॥
उपोष्य इंद्रो विधिवत्सुरामरिचसप्तमीम् ॥ 45 ॥
1.214.m: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, perform this [rite] which grants what is dear; / having fasted on the maricasaptamī according to rule, Indra

1.214.s:
saṃyogaṃ kṛtavānvīra saha śacyā vidhānataḥ ..
upoṣyaināṃ nalaścāpi damayantyā mahābalaḥ .. 46 ..
1.214.d:
संयोगं कृतवान्वीर सह शच्या विधानतः ॥
उपोष्यैनां नलश्चापि दमयन्त्या महाबलः ॥ 46 ॥
1.214.m: was reunited with Śacī in accordance with the rite, O hero; / having also fasted on this [tithi], the mighty Nala [was reunited] with Damayantī;

1.214.s:
rāmo'gātsītayā sārdhamupoṣyaināṃ narādhipa .. 47 ..
sūryamantroddhāravarṇanam
1.214.d:
रामोऽगात्सीतया सार्धमुपोष्यैनां नराधिप ॥ 47 ॥
सूर्यमन्त्रोद्धारवर्णनम्
1.214.m:
and Rāma was united with Sītā after fasting on this [tithi], O lord of men.
Description of the Extraction of the Sūrya Mantra

1.215.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca.. ..
tṛtīyāṃ saptamī vīra śṛṇuṣva gadato mama ..
niṃbapatraiḥ smṛtā yā tu paramā roganāśinī.. 1 ..
1.215.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच॥ ॥
तृतीयां सप्तमी वीर शृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥
निंबपत्रैः स्मृता या तु परमा रोगनाशिनी॥ 1 ॥
1.215.m: Sumantu said: / Hear, O hero, as I speak of the third saptamī, / which is observed with neem leaves, the supreme destroyer of disease,

1.215.s:
yathārcanavidhirvānyo yena pūjayate ravim..
devadevaḥ śārṅgapāṇiḥ śaṃkha cakragadādharaḥ .. 2 ..
1.215.d:
यथार्चनविधिर्वान्यो येन पूजयते रविम्॥
देवदेवः शार्ङ्गपाणिः शंख चक्रगदाधरः ॥ 2 ॥
1.215.m: or the other procedure of worship by which the Sun is worshipped / by the god of gods who holds the bow Śārṅga and bears the conch, discus, and mace.
Now I shall tell the procedure of worship; learn from me the extraction of the mantra.

1.215.s:
oṃ khaṣolkāya namaḥ .. mūlamaṃtraḥ ..
oṃ viṭi 2 śiraḥ ..
oṃ sahasraraśma ye astram ..
oṃ sahasrakiraṇāya 200 ūrdhvabaṃdhaḥ ..
oṃ ghanāya bhūtabhāvine namaḥ iti bhūtabaṃdhaḥ ..
oṃ jvala 2 prajvala 2 agniprakara .. 4 ..
1.215.d:
ओं खषोल्काय नमः ॥ मूलमंत्रः ॥
ओं विटि 2 शिरः ॥
ओं सहस्ररश्म ये अस्त्रम् ॥
ओं सहस्रकिरणाय 200 ऊर्ध्वबंधः ॥
ओं घनाय भूतभाविने नमः इति भूतबंधः ॥
ओं ज्वल 2 प्रज्वल 2 अग्निप्रकर ॥ 4 ॥
1.215.m: Oṃ, homage to Khaṣolka—the root mantra. / Oṃ viṭi viṭi—the head. / Oṃ, to the Thousand-Rayed One—the weapon. / Oṃ, to the Thousand-Beamed One, 200—the upward binding. / Oṃ, homage to the dense one who brings about living beings—thus the binding of the elements. / Oṃ, blaze, blaze, blaze forth, blaze forth—the circle of fire.

1.215.s:
oṃ ādityāya vidmahe viśvabhāgāya dhīmahi ..
tannaḥ sūryaḥ pracodayāt .. 5 ..
gāyatrīsaṃkalīkaraṇamidam ..
oṃ dharmātmane namaḥ .. eśānyām ..
oṃ dakṣiṇāya namaḥ āgneyyām ..
oṃ vajrapāṇaye'naṃtāya namaḥ uttarataḥ ..
oṃ śyāmapiṃgalāya namaḥ aiśānyām ..
oṃ amṛtāya namaḥ āgneyyām ..
oṃ budhāya somasutāya namo dakṣiṇataḥ ..
oṃvāgīśvarāya sarvavidyādhipataye nairṛtyām ..
oṃ śukrāya maharṣaye bhūtāya paścimataḥ ..
oṃ īśvarāya sūryātmane namo vāyavyām ..
oṃ kṛtavate namaḥ uttarataḥ ..
oṃ rāhave namaḥ aiśānyām..
oṃ aṃtarāya sūryātmane namaḥ pūrvataḥ..
oṃ dhruvāya namaḥ aiśānyām ..
oṃ bhagavate pūṣanmālinsakalajagatpate saptāśvavāhana bhūbhuja paramasiddhiśirasi gataṃ gṛhṇa tejorūpaṃ anaṃtajvāla 2 .. āvāhanamaṃtraḥ ..
1.215.d:
ओं आदित्याय विद्महे विश्वभागाय धीमहि ॥
तन्नः सूर्यः प्रचोदयात् ॥ 5 ॥
गायत्रीसंकलीकरणमिदम् ॥
ओं धर्मात्मने नमः ॥ एशान्याम् ॥
ओं दक्षिणाय नमः आग्नेय्याम् ॥
ओं वज्रपाणयेऽनंताय नमः उत्तरतः ॥
ओं श्यामपिंगलाय नमः ऐशान्याम् ॥
ओं अमृताय नमः आग्नेय्याम् ॥
ओं बुधाय सोमसुताय नमो दक्षिणतः ॥
ओंवागीश्वराय सर्वविद्याधिपतये नैरृत्याम् ॥
ओं शुक्राय महर्षये भूताय पश्चिमतः ॥
ओं ईश्वराय सूर्यात्मने नमो वायव्याम् ॥
ओं कृतवते नमः उत्तरतः ॥
ओं राहवे नमः ऐशान्याम्॥
ओं अंतराय सूर्यात्मने नमः पूर्वतः॥
ओं ध्रुवाय नमः ऐशान्याम् ॥
ओं भगवते पूषन्मालिन्सकलजगत्पते सप्ताश्ववाहन भूभुज परमसिद्धिशिरसि गतं गृह्ण तेजोरूपं अनंतज्वाल 2 ॥ आवाहनमंत्रः ॥
1.215.m:
Oṃ, we know Āditya; we meditate on Viśvabhāga; / may that Sūrya inspire us.
This is the integration of the Gāyatrī: / Oṃ, homage to the Embodiment of Dharma—in the northeast. / Oṃ, homage to the southern one—in the southeast. / Oṃ, homage to the infinite one who holds the thunderbolt in his hand—in the north. / Oṃ, homage to the dark and tawny one—in the northeast. / Oṃ, homage to the immortal one—in the southeast. / Oṃ, homage to Budha, son of Soma—in the south. / Oṃ, [homage] to the Lord of Speech, the master of all knowledge—in the southwest. / Oṃ, homage to the great sage Śukra, who has become [manifest]—in the west. / Oṃ, homage to the Sovereign, the Embodiment of the Sun—in the northwest. / Oṃ, homage to the one who has acted—in the north. / Oṃ, homage to Rāhu—in the northeast. / Oṃ, homage to the inner one, the Embodiment of the Sun—in the east. / Oṃ, homage to Dhruva—in the northeast. / Oṃ, O Blessed One, Pūṣan adorned with garlands, Lord of the entire universe, who has seven horses for his conveyance, King of the earth, who has reached the pinnacle of supreme perfection, receive [this] form of splendour, O you of infinite flame, flame—the mantra of invocation.

1.215.s:
oṃ namo bhagavate ādityāya sahasrakiraṇāya yathāsukhaṃ punarāgamanāya iti .. 6 ..
purāṇaśravaṇavidhivarṇanam
1.215.d:
ओं नमो भगवते आदित्याय सहस्रकिरणाय यथासुखं पुनरागमनाय इति ॥ 6 ॥
पुराणश्रवणविधिवर्णनम्
1.215.m:
Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Āditya, of a thousand beams; until your joyful return—thus.
Description of the Procedure for Hearing the Purāṇa

1.216.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvarcāvidhiṃ rājanmaṃtrapūtena vāriṇā ..
prokṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena kimarthaṃ susamāhitaḥ .. 1 ..
1.216.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
शृणुष्वर्चाविधिं राजन्मंत्रपूतेन वारिणा ॥
प्रोक्षणीयं प्रयत्नेन किमर्थं सुसमाहितः ॥ 1 ॥
1.216.m: Sumantu said: / Hear, O king, the procedure of worship; with concentrated mind, / why must one diligently sprinkle with water consecrated by mantras?

1.216.s:
hadayādiṣvathāṃgeṣu maṃtraṃ vinyasya maṃtravit ..
ātmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ dhyātvā paricārasamanvitaḥ .. 2 ..
1.216.d:
हदयादिष्वथांगेषु मंत्रं विन्यस्य मंत्रवित् ॥
आत्मानं भास्करं ध्यात्वा परिचारसमन्वितः ॥ 2 ॥
1.216.m: Having installed the mantra upon the heart and other limbs, the knower of mantras, / meditating upon himself as the Sun, accompanied by attendants—

1.216.s:
kuryātsaṃmārjanīṃ mudrāṃ diśāṃ ca pratibodhanam ..
pātāle bhūśodhanaṃ caiva nabhasaśca tathā matam .. 3 ..
1.216.d:
कुर्यात्संमार्जनीं मुद्रां दिशां च प्रतिबोधनम् ॥
पाताले भूशोधनं चैव नभसश्च तथा मतम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.216.m: One should form the sweeping hand-gesture and awaken the directions; / purifying the earth below in the netherworld, and likewise the sky, is prescribed.

1.216.s:
arcanasya prakāro'yaṃ sarveṣāmīpsitapradaḥ ..
sarvairapi budhairvīra padmametatprakīrtitam .. 4 ..
1.216.d:
अर्चनस्य प्रकारोऽयं सर्वेषामीप्सितप्रदः ॥
सर्वैरपि बुधैर्वीर पद्ममेतत्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.216.m: This method of worship grants all their desires. / By all the wise, O hero, this is celebrated as the lotus.

1.216.s:
aṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ śucau deśe sakarṇikam ..
āvāhanīṃ tato baddhvā mudrāmāvāhayedravim .. 5 ..
1.216.d:
अष्टपत्रं लिखेत्पद्मं शुचौ देशे सकर्णिकम् ॥
आवाहनीं ततो बद्ध्वा मुद्रामावाहयेद्रविम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.216.m: One should draw an eight-petalled lotus in a pure spot, along with its pericarp; / then, forming the invocation gesture, one should invoke the sun.

1.216.s:
khaṣolkaṃ snāpayettatra svarūpaṃ lobhadāyakam ..
sthāpayetsnāpayeccaiva maṃtrai maṃtraśarīriṇam .. 6 ..
1.216.d:
खषोल्कं स्नापयेत्तत्र स्वरूपं लोभदायकम् ॥
स्थापयेत्स्नापयेच्चैव मंत्रै मंत्रशरीरिणम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.216.m: There one should bathe Khaṣolka, whose true form inspires longing; / with mantras one should establish and bathe him whose body is mantra.

1.216.s:
āgneyyāṃ diśi devasya hṛdayaṃ sthāpayennaraḥ ..
aiśānyāṃ tu śiraḥ sthāpya nairṛtyāṃ vinyasecchikhām .. 7 ..
1.216.d:
आग्नेय्यां दिशि देवस्य हृदयं स्थापयेन्नरः ॥
ऐशान्यां तु शिरः स्थाप्य नैरृत्यां विन्यसेच्छिखाम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.216.m: A man should place the god's heart in the south-eastern direction; / placing the head in the north-east, he should place the topknot in the south-west.

1.216.s:
pauraṃdaryāṃ nyasennetre ekāmahṛdayastu saḥ ..
āvāhya caikaṃ kavacaṃ vāruṇyāmastrameva ca .. 8 ..
1.216.d:
पौरंदर्यां न्यसेन्नेत्रे एकामहृदयस्तु सः ॥
आवाह्य चैकं कवचं वारुण्यामस्त्रमेव च ॥ 8 ॥
1.216.m: He should place the eyes in the eastern direction, possessing a focused heart; / having invoked the single armour, [he should place] the weapon in the west.

1.216.s:
aiśānyāṃ sthāpayetsomaṃ pauraṃdaryāṃ tu lohitaḥ ..
āgneyyāṃ somatapanaṃ yāmyāṃ caiva bṛhaspatim .. 9 ..
1.216.d:
ऐशान्यां स्थापयेत्सोमं पौरंदर्यां तु लोहितः ॥
आग्नेय्यां सोमतपनं याम्यां चैव बृहस्पतिम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.216.m: In the north-east he should place Soma, and in the east Lohita; / in the south-east the Sun, and in the south Bṛhaspati;

1.216.s:
nairṛtyāṃ dānavaṃ śukraṃ vāruṇyāṃ ca śanaiścaram ..
vāyavyāṃ ca tathā ketuṃ kauberyāṃ rāhumeva ca .. 1.216.10 ..
1.216.d:
नैरृत्यां दानवं शुक्रं वारुण्यां च शनैश्चरम् ॥
वायव्यां च तथा केतुं कौबेर्यां राहुमेव च ॥ 1.216.10 ॥
1.216.m: in the south-west the Dānava Śukra, and in the west Śanaiścara; / likewise Ketu in the north-west, and Rāhu in the north.

1.216.s:
dvitīyāyāṃ tu kakṣāyāṃ devatejaḥsamudbhavān ..
sthāpayeddvādaśādityānkāśyapeyānmahābalān .. 11 ..
1.216.d:
द्वितीयायां तु कक्षायां देवतेजःसमुद्भवान् ॥
स्थापयेद्द्वादशादित्यान्काश्यपेयान्महाबलान् ॥ 11 ॥
1.216.m: In the second circuit, one should install the twelve Adityas / born from divine brilliance, the mighty sons of Kaśyapa:

1.216.s:
bhagaḥ sūryoryamaścaiva mitro varuṇa eva ca ..
savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvāṃśca mahābalaḥ .. 12 ..
1.216.d:
भगः सूर्योर्यमश्चैव मित्रो वरुण एव च ॥
सविता चैव धाता च विवस्वांश्च महाबलः ॥ 12 ॥
1.216.m: Bhaga, Sūrya, Aryaman, Mitra, and Varuṇa, / Savitṛ, Dhātṛ, and the mighty Vivasvant,

1.216.s:
tvaṣṭā pūṣā tathā rudro dvādaśo viṣṇurucyate ..
pūrve cendrāya dakṣiṇe yamāya paścime varuṇāya uttare kuberāya aiśānyāmīśvarāya āgneyyāmagnidevatāyai nairṛtyāṃ pitṛdevebhyo vāyavyāṃ vāyave ..
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī cāparājitā ..
śeṣaśca vāsukiścaiva revatī ca vināyakaḥ ..
mahāśvetā mahādevī rājñī caiva suvarcalā .. 13 ..
1.216.d:
त्वष्टा पूषा तथा रुद्रो द्वादशो विष्णुरुच्यते ॥
पूर्वे चेन्द्राय दक्षिणे यमाय पश्चिमे वरुणाय उत्तरे कुबेराय ऐशान्यामीश्वराय आग्नेय्यामग्निदेवतायै नैरृत्यां पितृदेवेभ्यो वायव्यां वायवे ॥
जया च विजया चैव जयंती चापराजिता ॥
शेषश्च वासुकिश्चैव रेवती च विनायकः ॥
महाश्वेता महादेवी राज्ञी चैव सुवर्चला ॥ 13 ॥
1.216.m: Tvaṣṭṛ, Pūṣan, Rudra, and the twelfth is said to be Viṣṇu. / In the east to Indra, in the south to Yama, in the west to Varuṇa, in the north to Kubera, in the north-east to Īśvara, in the south-east to the deity Agni, in the south-west to the ancestor-gods, in the north-west to Vāyu; / Jayā, Vijayā, Jayantī, and Aparājitā, / Śeṣa, Vāsuki, Revatī, and Vināyaka, / Mahāśvetā, Mahādevī, Rājñī, and Suvarcalā.

1.216.s:
tathānyo vāpi devānāṃ samūhasta tra tatra ha ..
tathānyo lokavikhyāto yogaḥ proktaśca dakṣiṇe .. 14 ..
1.216.d:
तथान्यो वापि देवानां समूहस्त त्र तत्र ह ॥
तथान्यो लोकविख्यातो योगः प्रोक्तश्च दक्षिणे ॥ 14 ॥
1.216.m: Likewise, another multitude of deities is there in each place; / likewise, another assembly famous in the world is proclaimed in the south.

1.216.s:
purastādbhāsurasthāne sthāpanīyā vijānatā ..
siddhirvṛddhiḥ smṛtirdevī śrīścaivotpalamālinī .. 15 ..
1.216.d:
पुरस्ताद्भासुरस्थाने स्थापनीया विजानता ॥
सिद्धिर्वृद्धिः स्मृतिर्देवी श्रीश्चैवोत्पलमालिनी ॥ 15 ॥
1.216.m: In front, in the luminous place, the knowing one should establish / Siddhi, Vṛddhi, Smṛti, the goddess Śrī, and Utpalamālinī.

1.216.s:
sthāpyā svadakṣiṇe pārśve lokapūjyā samaṃtataḥ ..
prājñāvatī kṣudhā vīra hārītā buddhireva ca .. 16 ..
1.216.d:
स्थाप्या स्वदक्षिणे पार्श्वे लोकपूज्या समंततः ॥
प्राज्ञावती क्षुधा वीर हारीता बुद्धिरेव च ॥ 16 ॥
1.216.m: To be established on his right side, revered by the world on all sides, / are Prājñāvatī, Kṣudhā, O hero, Hārītā, and Buddhi.

1.216.s:
sthāpya buddhimatī nityaṃ śrīkāmairvā vivasvataḥ ..
ṛddhiścaiva visṛṣṭiśca paurṇamāsī vibhāvarī..
sthāpyāśca svottare pārśve ityetā devaśaktayaḥ ..17..
1.216.d:
स्थाप्य बुद्धिमती नित्यं श्रीकामैर्वा विवस्वतः ॥
ऋद्धिश्चैव विसृष्टिश्च पौर्णमासी विभावरी॥
स्थाप्याश्च स्वोत्तरे पार्श्वे इत्येता देवशक्तयः ॥17॥
1.216.m: Buddhimatī must always be installed by those desiring prosperity from Vivasvant. / Ṛddhi, Visṛṣṭi, Paurṇamāsī, and Vibhāvarī / are to be installed on his left side: these are the powers of the god.

1.216.s:
dīpaścānnamalaṃkāro vāsaḥ puṣpāṇi mantrataḥ ..
deyāni devadevāya sānugāya samūrtaye ..18..
1.216.d:
दीपश्चान्नमलंकारो वासः पुष्पाणि मन्त्रतः ॥
देयानि देवदेवाय सानुगाय समूर्तये ॥18॥
1.216.m: A lamp, food, ornament, garment, and flowers / should be offered with mantras to the god of gods, who has attendants and form.

1.216.s:
vidhinānena satataṃ sadā yorcayati bhāskaram ..
saṃprāpya paramānkāmāṃstato bhānusado vrajet .. 19 ..
1.216.d:
विधिनानेन सततं सदा योर्चयति भास्करम् ॥
संप्राप्य परमान्कामांस्ततो भानुसदो व्रजेत् ॥ 19 ॥
1.216.m: Whoever continually worships the sun in this manner / obtains supreme desires and goes to the abode of the sun.

1.216.s:
anena vidhinā yastu bhojayedbhāskaraṃ nṛpa ..
tvaṃ niṃba kaṭukātmāsi ādityanilayastathā ..
sarvarogaharaḥ śānto bhava me prāśanaṃ sadā .. 1.216.20 ..
1.216.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु भोजयेद्भास्करं नृप ॥
त्वं निंब कटुकात्मासि आदित्यनिलयस्तथा ॥
सर्वरोगहरः शान्तो भव मे प्राशनं सदा ॥ 1.216.20 ॥
1.216.m: Whoever feeds the sun by this rule, O king: / 'You are neem, bitter in nature, and the dwelling of the sun; / banishing all diseases, peaceful, be my food always.'

1.216.s:
itthaṃ prāśya japedbhūmau devasya purato nṛpa ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu śaktyā dattvā tu dakṣiṇām.. 21 ..
1.216.d:
इत्थं प्राश्य जपेद्भूमौ देवस्य पुरतो नृप ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा तु शक्त्या दत्त्वा तु दक्षिणाम्॥ 21 ॥
1.216.m: Having thus eaten, he should recite prayers on the ground before the god, O king, / after feeding brāhmaṇas and giving a sacrificial fee according to his means.

1.216.s:
bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ paścānmadhuraṃ kṣāravarjitam ..
ityeṣā varṣaparyantaṃ kartavyā caiva saptamī .. 22 ..
1.216.d:
भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः पश्चान्मधुरं क्षारवर्जितम् ॥
इत्येषा वर्षपर्यन्तं कर्तव्या चैव सप्तमी ॥ 22 ॥
1.216.m: Restraining his speech, he should then eat sweet food, free from saline; / in this way, this saptamī is to be observed for a whole year.

1.216.s:
kurvāṇaḥ saptamīmetāṃ sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate ..
sarvaroga vinirmuktaḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 23 ..
1.216.d:
कुर्वाणः सप्तमीमेतां सर्वरोगैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
सर्वरोग विनिर्मुक्तः सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति ॥ 23 ॥
1.216.m: Performing this saptamī, one is freed from all diseases; / delivered from all diseases, he goes to the world of the sun.

1.216.s:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
atha bhādrapade māsi site pakṣe mahīpate ..
kṛtvopavāsaṃ saptamyāṃ vidhivatpūjayedravim .. 24 ..
1.216.d:
॥ सुमन्तुरुवाच ॥ ॥
अथ भाद्रपदे मासि सिते पक्षे महीपते ॥
कृत्वोपवासं सप्तम्यां विधिवत्पूजयेद्रविम् ॥ 24 ॥
1.216.m: Sumantu said: / Now in the month of Bhādrapada, in the bright fortnight, O lord of the earth, / having fasted on the seventh day, one should worship the sun according to rule.

1.216.s:
māheśvareṇa vidhinā pūjayedatra bhāskaram ..
aṣṭamyāṃ tu punaḥ snātaḥ pūjayitvā divākaram .. 25 ..
1.216.d:
माहेश्वरेण विधिना पूजयेदत्र भास्करम् ॥
अष्टम्यां तु पुनः स्नातः पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.216.m: One should worship the sun here with the Māheśvara rite; / having bathed again on the eighth day and worshipped the sun,

1.216.s:
dadyātphalāni viprebhyo mārtaṇḍaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
kharjūraṃ nālikeraṃ ca mātuliṅgaphalāni ca .. 26 ..
1.216.d:
दद्यात्फलानि विप्रेभ्यो मार्तण्डः प्रीयतामिति ॥
खर्जूरं नालिकेरं च मातुलिङ्गफलानि च ॥ 26 ॥
1.216.m: he should give fruits to the brāhmaṇas, saying, 'May Mārtaṇḍa be pleased': / dates, coconuts, and citron fruits.

1.216.s:
devasya purato dattvā tathā cāmraphalāni ca ..
iti te kathitaṃ rājansaptamīphalamāditaḥ .. 27 ..
1.216.d:
देवस्य पुरतो दत्त्वा तथा चाम्रफलानि च ॥
इति ते कथितं राजन्सप्तमीफलमादितः ॥ 27 ॥
1.216.m: Having placed [them] before the god, and likewise mango fruits— / thus has the fruit of the saptamī been told to you from the beginning, O king.

1.216.s:
mahātapo mahāśreṣṭhaṃ bhāskarasya viśāmpate ..
yacchrutvā mānavo rājanmucyate brahmahatyayā .. 28 ..
1.216.d:
महातपो महाश्रेष्ठं भास्करस्य विशाम्पते ॥
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो राजन्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया ॥ 28 ॥
1.216.m: It is the great, supreme austerity of the sun, O ruler of the people, / hearing which a man is freed from the killing of a brāhmaṇa, O king.

1.216.s:
tathedaṃ paramaṃ parva kathitaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam ..
yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyante mānavā nṛpa .. 29 ..
1.216.d:
तथेदं परमं पर्व कथितं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् ॥
यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यन्ते मानवा नृप ॥ 29 ॥
1.216.m: Likewise, this supreme section called Brahma has been proclaimed, / hearing which men are freed from all sins, O king.

1.216.s:
aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca ..
sarvatīrthābhigamane vedābhyāse ca yatphalam ..
yatphalaṃ pṛthivīdāne tatsarvaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 1.216.30 ..
1.216.d:
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य वाजपेयशतस्य च ॥
सर्वतीर्थाभिगमने वेदाभ्यासे च यत्फलम् ॥
यत्फलं पृथिवीदाने तत्सर्वं प्राप्नुयान्नरः ॥ 1.216.30 ॥
1.216.m: The fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices, of a hundred vājapeyas, / of going to all sacred fords, and of the study of the Vedas; / whatever fruit lies in gifting the earth—a man obtains all of that.

1.216.s:
rājasūyasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca ..
sahasraśatadānasya phalaṃ viṃdati mānavaḥ .. 31 ..
1.216.d:
राजसूयसहस्रस्य वाजपेयशतस्य च ॥
सहस्रशतदानस्य फलं विंदति मानवः ॥ 31 ॥
1.216.m: The fruit of a thousand rājasūyas, of a hundred vājapeyas, / and of a hundred thousand gifts, a mortal attains.

1.216.s:
lekhatvaṃ brāhmaṇo gacchetkṣatriyo vipratāṃ vrajet ..
vaiśyo'pi kṣatratāṃ yāti śūdro vaiśyatvameva ca .. 32 ..
1.216.d:
लेखत्वं ब्राह्मणो गच्छेत्क्षत्रियो विप्रतां व्रजेत् ॥
वैश्योऽपि क्षत्रतां याति शूद्रो वैश्यत्वमेव च ॥ 32 ॥
1.216.m: A brāhmaṇa would attain the status of a god, a kṣatriya would become a brāhmaṇa, / a vaiśya also attains kṣatriya status, and a śūdra attains vaiśya status.

1.216.s:
sūtamāgadha bandyādyā ye cānye saṃkarodbhavāḥ ..
te'pi yāṃtyuttamaṃ sthānaṃ purāṇaśravaṇādvibho .. 33 ..
1.216.d:
सूतमागध बन्द्याद्या ये चान्ये संकरोद्भवाः ॥
तेऽपि यांत्युत्तमं स्थानं पुराणश्रवणाद्विभो ॥ 33 ॥
1.216.m: Sūtas, Māgadhas, bards, and others who are of mixed birth / also go to the supreme state from hearing the Purāṇa, O lord.

1.216.s:
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ na tvanyatpāvanaṃ nṛṇām ..
yeṣāṃ śravaṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 34 ..
1.216.d:
इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां न त्वन्यत्पावनं नृणाम् ॥
येषां श्रवणमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥ 34 ॥
1.216.m: There is nothing more purifying for men than the Itihāsa and Purāṇa, / merely by hearing which one is freed from all sins.

1.216.s:
vidhinā rājaśārdūla śṛṇvatāṃ yatphalaṃ kila ..
yathoktaṃ nātra saṃdehaḥ paṭhatāṃ ca viśāṃpate .. 35 .. ..
1.216.d:
विधिना राजशार्दूल शृण्वतां यत्फलं किल ॥
यथोक्तं नात्र संदेहः पठतां च विशांपते ॥ 35 ॥ ॥
1.216.m: Whatever fruit is told for those listening according to rule, O tiger among kings, / is as stated, without doubt, and for those reading it, O ruler of the people.

1.216.s:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
bhagavankena vidhinā śrotavyaṃ bhārataṃ naraiḥ ..
caritaṃ rāmabhadrasya purāṇāni viśeṣataḥ .. 36 ..
1.216.d:
॥ शतानीक उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्केन विधिना श्रोतव्यं भारतं नरैः ॥
चरितं रामभद्रस्य पुराणानि विशेषतः ॥ 36 ॥
1.216.m: Śatānīka said: / Blessed one, by what rule should the Bhārata be heard by men, / the deeds of Rāmabhadra, and especially the Purāṇas?

1.216.s:
kathaṃ tu vaiṣṇavā dharmāḥ śivadharmā aśeṣataḥ ..
saurāṇāṃ cāpi viprendra ucyatāṃ śravaṇe vidhiḥ .. 37 ..
1.216.d:
कथं तु वैष्णवा धर्माः शिवधर्मा अशेषतः ॥
सौराणां चापि विप्रेन्द्र उच्यतां श्रवणे विधिः ॥ 37 ॥
1.216.m: How are the Vaiṣṇava teachings, the Śaiva teachings in their entirety, / and those of the Sauras [to be heard], O foremost of brāhmaṇas? Let the rule for hearing be told.

1.216.s:
vācanīyaṃ kathaṃ cāpi vācako dvijasattama ..
lakṣaṇaṃ cāsya me brūhi vācakasya mahātmanaḥ .. 38 ..
1.216.d:
वाचनीयं कथं चापि वाचको द्विजसत्तम ॥
लक्षणं चास्य मे ब्रूहि वाचकस्य महात्मनः ॥ 38 ॥
1.216.m: And how is it to be recited? What kind is the reciter, O best of the twice-born? / Tell me the characteristics of this noble reciter.

1.216.s:
svarūpaṃ cāsya me brūhi khaṣolkasya mahātmanaḥ ..
phalaṃ ca pūjite kiṃ syādvācake vidhivaddvija .. .. 39 ..
1.216.d:
स्वरूपं चास्य मे ब्रूहि खषोल्कस्य महात्मनः ॥
फलं च पूजिते किं स्याद्वाचके विधिवद्द्विज ॥ ॥ 39 ॥
1.216.m: Tell me the true form of this noble Khaṣolka, / and what fruit would come when the reciter is worshipped according to rule, O twice-born?

1.216.s:
pāraṇepāraṇe pūjyo vācakaḥ śrāvakaiḥ katham ..
samāpte bhagavankiṃkiṃ deyaṃ parvaṇi vācake .. 1.216.40 ..
1.216.d:
पारणेपारणे पूज्यो वाचकः श्रावकैः कथम् ॥
समाप्ते भगवन्किंकिं देयं पर्वणि वाचके ॥ 1.216.40 ॥
1.216.m: At each completion of a fast, how should the reciter be honoured by the listeners? / When it is concluded, blessed one, what should be given to the reciter at the occasion?

1.216.s:
na ca kiṃ kāryasiddhaṃ yatsiddhaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi ..
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
samyakpṛṣṭo'smi rājendra itihāsapurāṇayoḥ .. 41 ..
1.216.d:
न च किं कार्यसिद्धं यत्सिद्धं पर्वणि पर्वणि ॥
॥ सुमन्तुरुवाच ॥ ॥
सम्यक्पृष्टोऽस्मि राजेन्द्र इतिहासपुराणयोः ॥ 41 ॥
1.216.m: And what task is accomplished that is perfected at each occasion? / Sumantu said: / I have been questioned well, O ruler of kings, on the Itihāsa and Purāṇa.

1.216.s:
śravaṇe tu mahābāho śrūyatāṃ yanmayā purā ..
pṛṣṭo vocanmahātejā viriṃco bhagavānguruḥ .. 42 ..
1.216.d:
श्रवणे तु महाबाहो श्रूयतां यन्मया पुरा ॥
पृष्टो वोचन्महातेजा विरिंचो भगवान्गुरुः ॥ 42 ॥
1.216.m: Regarding hearing them, O mighty-armed one, hear what formerly, / when asked by me, the blessed teacher, brilliant Viriñci, spoke.

1.216.s:
haṃta te kathayāmyeṣa purāṇaśravaṇe vidhim ..
itihāsapurāṇāni śrutvā bhaktyā viśeṣataḥ ..
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo brahmahatyādibhirvibho .. 43 ..
1.216.d:
हंत ते कथयाम्येष पुराणश्रवणे विधिम् ॥
इतिहासपुराणानि श्रुत्वा भक्त्या विशेषतः ॥
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो ब्रह्महत्यादिभिर्विभो ॥ 43 ॥
1.216.m:
Lo, I shall tell you the rule for hearing the Purāṇas.
Having heard the Itihāsas and Purāṇas, especially with devotion, / one is freed from all sins such as killing a brāhmaṇa, O mighty lord.

1.216.s:
sāyaṃ prātastathā rātrau śucirbhūtvā śṛṇoti yaḥ ..
tasya viṣṇustathā brahmā tuṣyate śaṃkarastathā .. 44 ..
1.216.d:
सायं प्रातस्तथा रात्रौ शुचिर्भूत्वा शृणोति यः ॥
तस्य विष्णुस्तथा ब्रह्मा तुष्यते शंकरस्तथा ॥ 44 ॥
1.216.m: He who, having become pure, listens in the evening, in the morning, and at night, / Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Śaṅkara are pleased with him.

1.216.s:
pratyūṣe bhagavānbrahmā dināṃte tuṣyate hariḥ ..
mahādevastathā rātrau śṛṇvatāṃ tuṣyate vibhuḥ ..
pāraṇāni daśāheṣu eke kurvaṃti tāni bhoḥ .. 45 ..
1.216.d:
प्रत्यूषे भगवान्ब्रह्मा दिनांते तुष्यते हरिः ॥
महादेवस्तथा रात्रौ शृण्वतां तुष्यते विभुः ॥
पारणानि दशाहेषु एके कुर्वंति तानि भोः ॥ 45 ॥
1.216.m:
At dawn the lord Brahmā is pleased, at day's end Hari is pleased; / likewise at night the all-pervading Mahādeva is pleased with those who listen.
Some perform concluding feasts on the tenth days, O lord;

1.216.s:
bhavedvai rājaśārdūla śṛṇu teṣāṃ ca yatphalam ..
vidhānaṃ vācakasyeha śṛṇvatāṃ ca viśāṃpate..46..
1.216.d:
भवेद्वै राजशार्दूल शृणु तेषां च यत्फलम् ॥
विधानं वाचकस्येह शृण्वतां च विशांपते॥46॥
1.216.m: it may be so indeed, O tiger among kings; listen to their fruit, / and to the rule here for the reciter and for the listeners, O ruler of subjects.

1.216.s:
śuddhavāsā gṛhādetya sthānaṃ yatsamayānvitam ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ tato gatvā yastasmindeva eva hi .. 47 ..
1.216.d:
शुद्धवासा गृहादेत्य स्थानं यत्समयान्वितम् ॥
प्रदक्षिणं ततो गत्वा यस्तस्मिन्देव एव हि ॥ 47 ॥
1.216.m: Having come from home wearing clean clothes to the place that is properly arranged, / and having then circumambulated whichever deity is present there,

1.216.s:
nātyuccaṃ nātinīcaṃ ca hyāsanaṃ bhajate tataḥ ..
āsanaṃ tasya vai rājanbodhakasya sadā bhavet .. 48 ..
1.216.d:
नात्युच्चं नातिनीचं च ह्यासनं भजते ततः ॥
आसनं तस्य वै राजन्बोधकस्य सदा भवेत् ॥ 48 ॥
1.216.m:
he then takes a seat that is neither too high nor too low.
That seat indeed, O king, should always belong to the instructor.

1.216.s:
vandanīyaṃ prapūjya ca śrotṛbhiḥ kurunandana ..
vyāsapīṭhaṃ tu tatproktaṃ gurorāsanamādiśet .. 49 ..
1.216.d:
वन्दनीयं प्रपूज्य च श्रोतृभिः कुरुनन्दन ॥
व्यासपीठं तु तत्प्रोक्तं गुरोरासनमादिशेत् ॥ 49 ॥
1.216.m:
It should be revered and worshipped by the listeners, O scion of the Kurus.
It is declared to be the seat of Vyāsa; one should designate it as the seat of the guru.

1.216.s:
na stheyaṃ śrāvakaistasmādvācakasyāsane nṛpa ..
rājāsane yathā bhṛtyairyathā putraiḥ piturnṛpa .. 1.216.50 ..
1.216.d:
न स्थेयं श्रावकैस्तस्माद्वाचकस्यासने नृप ॥
राजासने यथा भृत्यैर्यथा पुत्रैः पितुर्नृप ॥ 1.216.50 ॥
1.216.m: Therefore the listeners must not remain on the seat of the reciter, O king, / just as servants do not remain on a king's seat, or sons on their father's, O king,

1.216.s:
yathā śiśurgurorvīra sa teṣāṃ hi gururmataḥ ..
devārcāmagrataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇārcāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 51 ..
1.216.d:
यथा शिशुर्गुरोर्वीर स तेषां हि गुरुर्मतः ॥
देवार्चामग्रतः कृत्वा ब्राह्मणार्चां विशेषतः ॥ 51 ॥
1.216.m:
just as a child [does not remain on the seat] of his guru, O hero, for he is regarded as their guru.
Having first performed the worship of the gods, especially the worship of brāhmaṇas,

1.216.s:
upa viśya tataḥ paścācchrāvakaḥ śṛṇuyānnṛpa ..
samastānāgatānkṛtvā tataḥ pustakamādadet .. 52 ..
1.216.d:
उप विश्य ततः पश्चाच्छ्रावकः शृणुयान्नृप ॥
समस्तानागतान्कृत्वा ततः पुस्तकमाददेत् ॥ 52 ॥
1.216.m:
and having seated himself thereafter, the listener should listen, O king.
Having ensured that all have arrived, he should then take up the manuscript.

1.216.s:
praṇamya śirasā tasya pustakasya viśāṃpate ..
graṃthiṃ ca śithilāṃ kuryādvācakaḥ kurunandana ..
punarbadhnīta tatsūtraṃ tanmuktvā vācayetkvacit .. 53 ..
1.216.d:
प्रणम्य शिरसा तस्य पुस्तकस्य विशांपते ॥
ग्रंथिं च शिथिलां कुर्याद्वाचकः कुरुनन्दन ॥
पुनर्बध्नीत तत्सूत्रं तन्मुक्त्वा वाचयेत्क्वचित् ॥ 53 ॥
1.216.m:
Having bowed with his head to that manuscript, O ruler of subjects, / the reciter should loosen its knot, O scion of the Kurus.
He should bind that cord again, or having released it, he may recite anywhere.

1.216.s:
trividhaṃ pustakaṃ vidyātsūtraṃ vāsukirucyate ..
patrāṇi bhagavānbrahmā akṣarāṇi janārdanaḥ ..54..
1.216.d:
त्रिविधं पुस्तकं विद्यात्सूत्रं वासुकिरुच्यते ॥
पत्राणि भगवान्ब्रह्मा अक्षराणि जनार्दनः ॥54॥
1.216.m: One should know that the manuscript has a threefold nature: the cord is said to be Vāsuki, / the leaves are the lord Brahmā, and the syllables are Janārdana.

1.216.s:
śaṃkaraśca tathā sūtraṃ paṃktayaḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
pāvakaśca tathā sūtre madhye bhānuḥ samāśritaḥ ..55..
1.216.d:
शंकरश्च तथा सूत्रं पंक्तयः सर्वदेवताः ॥
पावकश्च तथा सूत्रे मध्ये भानुः समाश्रितः ॥55॥
1.216.m:
And Śaṅkara is the cord; the lines are all the deities;
Agni is in the cord, and the Sun resides in the middle.

1.216.s:
agre sthitā grahāḥ sarve diśo vāpi tathā vibho ..
smṛto meruḥ sadā śaṃkuśchidramākāśamucyate ..56..
1.216.d:
अग्रे स्थिता ग्रहाः सर्वे दिशो वापि तथा विभो ॥
स्मृतो मेरुः सदा शंकुश्छिद्रमाकाशमुच्यते ॥56॥
1.216.m:
All the planets stand in front, or likewise the directions, O mighty lord.
The pin is always traditionally remembered as Meru; the hole is said to be space.

1.216.s:
yaṃtradvayaṃ kāṣṭhamayamadhordhvaṃ yadudāhṛtam ..
dyāvāpṛthivyośca śaṃkhastathā caṃdra udāhṛtaḥ ..57..
1.216.d:
यंत्रद्वयं काष्ठमयमधोर्ध्वं यदुदाहृतम् ॥
द्यावापृथिव्योश्च शंखस्तथा चंद्र उदाहृतः ॥57॥
1.216.m: The pair of wooden boards, which are spoken of as lower and upper, / are Heaven and Earth; the conch is said to be the Moon.

1.216.s:
itthaṃ devamayaṃ hyetatpustakaṃ devapūjitam ..
namasyaṃ pūjanīyañca gṛhe sthāpyaṃ vibhūtaye.. 58 ..
1.216.d:
इत्थं देवमयं ह्येतत्पुस्तकं देवपूजितम् ॥
नमस्यं पूजनीयञ्च गृहे स्थाप्यं विभूतये॥ 58 ॥
1.216.m:
Thus this manuscript is composed of the gods and worshipped by the gods.
It is to be saluted, worshipped, and kept in the house for prosperity.

1.216.s:
yo'sya sūtraṃ bṛhatkṛtvā prayacchati narottamaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ..59..
1.216.d:
योऽस्य सूत्रं बृहत्कृत्वा प्रयच्छति नरोत्तमः ॥
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः॥59॥
1.216.m: That best of men who, having made its cord large, offers it, / goes to the supreme realm where the god Sun resides.

1.216.s:
nirūpya pātraṃ rājendra karābhyāṃ gṛhya vācakaḥ ..
praṇamya śirasā sarvānbrahmādīnvyāsameva ca ..
vālmīkiṃ ca tathā rājanvidhiṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ ravim..1.216.60..
1.216.d:
निरूप्य पात्रं राजेन्द्र कराभ्यां गृह्य वाचकः ॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा सर्वान्ब्रह्मादीन्व्यासमेव च ॥
वाल्मीकिं च तथा राजन्विधिं विष्णुं शिवं रविम्॥1.216.60॥
1.216.m: Having inspected the page, O best of kings, and taking it with both hands, / the reciter, bowing with his head to all, beginning with Brahmā, and to Vyāsa,

1.216.s:
namaskāramathaiṣāṃ tu paṭhitvā kurunaṃdana..
tatosau vyāharedviprānvācakaḥ śradayānvitaḥ61.. .
alaṃbitamatastabdhamadbhutaṃ vīramūrjitam ..
asaṃsaktākṣarapadaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam .. 62 ..
1.216.d:
नमस्कारमथैषां तु पठित्वा कुरुनंदन॥
ततोसौ व्याहरेद्विप्रान्वाचकः श्रदयान्वितः61॥ ।
अलंबितमतस्तब्धमद्भुतं वीरमूर्जितम् ॥
असंसक्ताक्षरपदं रसभावसमन्वितम् ॥ 62 ॥
1.216.m: and likewise, O king, to Vālmīki, to the Creator, to Viṣṇu, to Śiva, and to the Sun, / and having recited their homage, O scion of the Kurus, / that reciter, endowed with faith, should then address the brāhmaṇas: / unhurried, not stiff, wondrous, heroic, energetic, / with words and syllables distinct, endowed with aesthetic flavors and emotional states,

1.216.s:
saptasvarasamāyuktaṃ kālekāle viśāṃpate ..
pradarśayanrasāntsarvānvācako vyāharennṛpa .. 63 ..
1.216.d:
सप्तस्वरसमायुक्तं कालेकाले विशांपते ॥
प्रदर्शयन्रसान्त्सर्वान्वाचको व्याहरेन्नृप ॥ 63 ॥
1.216.m: endowed with the seven musical notes, at the proper times, O ruler of subjects; / displaying all aesthetic flavors, the reciter should speak, O king.

1.216.s:
īdṛśādvācakādviprācchrutvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
itihāsapurāṇāni rāmasya caritaṃ tathā.. 64..
1.216.d:
ईदृशाद्वाचकाद्विप्राच्छ्रुत्वा श्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥
इतिहासपुराणानि रामस्य चरितं तथा॥ 64॥
1.216.m: Having heard from such a brāhmaṇa reciter, endowed with faith, / the Itihāsas and Purāṇas, as well as the deeds of Rāma,

1.216.s:
niyamasthaḥ śuciḥ śrotā śṛṇuyātphalamaśnute ..
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāpi viśeṣataḥ .. 65 ..
1.216.d:
नियमस्थः शुचिः श्रोता शृणुयात्फलमश्नुते ॥
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रश्चापि विशेषतः ॥ 65 ॥
1.216.m:
the listener, established in rules and pure, who listens enjoys the fruit:
a brāhmaṇa, a kṣatriya, a vaiśya, and especially a śūdra.

1.216.s:
aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvānkāmānavāpnute ..
rogaiśca mucyate sarvairmahatpuṇyaṃ ca viṃdati ..
gacchedvāpi paraṃ sthānaṃ devasyādbhutamuttamam ..66..
1.216.d:
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुते ॥
रोगैश्च मुच्यते सर्वैर्महत्पुण्यं च विंदति ॥
गच्छेद्वापि परं स्थानं देवस्याद्भुतमुत्तमम् ॥66॥
1.216.m: He attains the horse sacrifice, he attains all desires, / he is freed from all diseases, and he obtains great religious merit; / or he may go to the supreme, wonderful, excellent realm of the god.

1.216.s:
snātairgṛhaṃ samāgamya śrotṛbhirvācakasya tu ..
praṇamya śirasā vipraṃ vācakaṃ śraddhayā nṛpa..67..
1.216.d:
स्नातैर्गृहं समागम्य श्रोतृभिर्वाचकस्य तु ॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा विप्रं वाचकं श्रद्धया नृप॥67॥
1.216.m: Having bathed and assembled at the house of the reciter, / the listeners, bowing with the head to the brāhmaṇa reciter with faith, O king,

1.216.s:
āsanaṃ ca samāśritya sthātavyaṃ vācakasya tu..
saṃmukhaṃ rājaśārdūla vāgyataiḥ susamāhitaiḥ..68..
1.216.d:
आसनं च समाश्रित्य स्थातव्यं वाचकस्य तु॥
संमुखं राजशार्दूल वाग्यतैः सुसमाहितैः॥68॥
1.216.m: and taking a seat facing the reciter, / they should remain, O tiger among kings, restrained in speech and thoroughly composed.

1.216.s:
vācakena namaskāre kṛte vyāsasya bhūpate..
na vaktavyaṃ mahābāho śrāvakaiḥ saṃśayādṛte ..69..
1.216.d:
वाचकेन नमस्कारे कृते व्यासस्य भूपते॥
न वक्तव्यं महाबाहो श्रावकैः संशयादृते ॥69॥
1.216.m: When the reciter has made his salutation to Vyāsa, O lord of the earth, / nothing should be spoken by the listeners, O mighty-armed one, except for a doubt.

1.216.s:
saṃśaye sati praṣṭavyo vācakaḥ saṃprasādya tu ..
yataśca sa gurusteṣāṃ dharmato baṃdhurucyate..1.216.70..
1.216.d:
संशये सति प्रष्टव्यो वाचकः संप्रसाद्य तु ॥
यतश्च स गुरुस्तेषां धर्मतो बंधुरुच्यते॥1.216.70॥
1.216.m: When there is a doubt, the reciter is to be questioned after propitiating him, / for he is their guru and is called their kin according to dharma.

1.216.s:
vācakenāpi vaktavyaṃ yatsyātteṣāṃ nibodhanam ..
anugrahāya sarveṣāmaśeṣā guravo nṛpa .. 71 ..
1.216.d:
वाचकेनापि वक्तव्यं यत्स्यात्तेषां निबोधनम् ॥
अनुग्रहाय सर्वेषामशेषा गुरवो नृप ॥ 71 ॥
1.216.m:
And the reciter should speak that which will bring about their comprehension;
for gurus, without exception, are for the grace of all, O king.

1.216.s:
namaskārādayaḥ śrāvyā śivamastviti vodyate ..
vāgyatairnṛpaśārdla varṇaiḥ sarvairmahīpate..72..
1.216.d:
नमस्कारादयः श्राव्या शिवमस्त्विति वोद्यते ॥
वाग्यतैर्नृपशार्द्ल वर्णैः सर्वैर्महीपते॥72॥
1.216.m: Salutations and the like are to be made heard, saying 'May there be auspiciousness,' / with restrained speech, by all the social classes, O tiger among kings, O lord of the earth.

1.216.s:
śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyā vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriṇastathā ..
madhyasthito'tha sarveṣāṃ vācako vyāharennṛpa ..
ye ca saṃkarajā rājannarāste śūdrapṛṣṭhataḥ .. 73 ..
1.216.d:
शूद्राणां पुरतो वैश्या वैश्यानां क्षत्रिणस्तथा ॥
मध्यस्थितोऽथ सर्वेषां वाचको व्याहरेन्नृप ॥
ये च संकरजा राजन्नरास्ते शूद्रपृष्ठतः ॥ 73 ॥

1.216.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ vācakaṃ vidyānnānyavarṇajamādaret ..
śrutvānyavarṇajādvācaṃ vācakānnarakaṃ vrajet .. 74 ..
1.216.d:
ब्राह्मणं वाचकं विद्यान्नान्यवर्णजमादरेत् ॥
श्रुत्वान्यवर्णजाद्वाचं वाचकान्नरकं व्रजेत् ॥ 74 ॥
1.216.m:
One should know the reciter to be a brāhmaṇa; one should not respect one born of another class.
Having heard the speech from a reciter born of another class, one would go to hell.

1.216.s:
itthaṃ hi śṛṇvatāṃ teṣāṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ ..
māsimāsi bhavedrājanpāraṇaṃ kurunandana .. 75 ..
1.216.d:
इत्थं हि शृण्वतां तेषां वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः ॥
मासिमासि भवेद्राजन्पारणं कुरुनन्दन ॥ 75 ॥
1.216.m: For those classes who thus listen in due order, / month after month there should be a concluding feast, O king, O scion of the Kurus.

1.216.s:
śreyo'rthamātmano rājanpūjayedvācakaṃ budhaḥ ..
māsi pūrṇe dvija śreṣṭhe dātavyaṃ svarṇamāṣakam .. 76 ..
1.216.d:
श्रेयोऽर्थमात्मनो राजन्पूजयेद्वाचकं बुधः ॥
मासि पूर्णे द्विज श्रेष्ठे दातव्यं स्वर्णमाषकम् ॥ 76 ॥
1.216.m:
For the sake of his own welfare, O king, a wise man should worship the reciter.
When the month is completed, a gold māṣaka should be given to the best of the twice-born:

1.216.s:
brāhmaṇena mahābāho dve deye kṣatriyasya tu ..
vācakāya dvijaśreṣṭha vaiśyenāpi trayaṃ tathā .. 77 ..
1.216.d:
ब्राह्मणेन महाबाहो द्वे देये क्षत्रियस्य तु ॥
वाचकाय द्विजश्रेष्ठ वैश्येनापि त्रयं तथा ॥ 77 ॥
1.216.m: by a brāhmaṇa, O mighty-armed one; but two are to be given by a kṣatriya / to the reciter, O best of the twice-born; and likewise three by a vaiśya,

1.216.s:
śūdreṇaiva ca catvāro dātavyāḥ svarṇamāṣakāḥ ..
māsimāsi dvijaśreṣṭha śraddhayā vācakāya tu .. 78 ..
1.216.d:
शूद्रेणैव च चत्वारो दातव्याः स्वर्णमाषकाः ॥
मासिमासि द्विजश्रेष्ठ श्रद्धया वाचकाय तु ॥ 78 ॥
1.216.m: and four gold māṣakas are to be given by a śūdra / month after month, O best of the twice-born, with faith to the reciter.

1.216.s:
prathame pāraṇe rājanvācakaṃ pūjya śaktitaḥ ..
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ viṃdati mānavaḥ .. 79 ..
1.216.d:
प्रथमे पारणे राजन्वाचकं पूज्य शक्तितः ॥
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं विंदति मानवः ॥ 79 ॥
1.216.m: At the first concluding feast, O king, having worshipped the reciter according to one's ability, / a man obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

1.216.s:
kārtikādīnsamārabhya yāvatkārttikamacyuta ..
agniṣṭomaṃ gosavaṃ ca jyotiṣṭomaṃ tathā nṛpa .. 1.216.80 ..
1.216.d:
कार्तिकादीन्समारभ्य यावत्कार्त्तिकमच्युत ॥
अग्निष्टोमं गोसवं च ज्योतिष्टोमं तथा नृप ॥ 1.216.80 ॥
1.216.m: Beginning from Kārttika and so forth up to Kārttika, O infallible one, / [the fruit of] the Agniṣṭoma, the Gosava, and likewise the Jyotiṣṭoma, O king,

1.216.s:
sautrāmaṇiṃ vājapeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā vibho ..
māheśvaraṃ tathā brāhmaṃ puṃḍarīkaṃ yajeta yaḥ .. 81 ..
1.216.d:
सौत्रामणिं वाजपेयं वैष्णवं च तथा विभो ॥
माहेश्वरं तथा ब्राह्मं पुंडरीकं यजेत यः ॥ 81 ॥
1.216.m: the Sautrāmaṇī, the Vājapeya, and likewise the Vaiṣṇava, O mighty lord, / the Māheśvara, and likewise the Brāhma, and the Puṇḍarīka, which one might sacrifice,

1.216.s:
ādityayajñasya tathā rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ..
